title: Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

  • Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

  • Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

  • Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

  • Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

  • Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

  • Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

  • Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

  • Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

  • Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

  • Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

  • Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

  • Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

  • Process & tools: Disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, and KPI ownership (win rate, cycle time, stage conversion, ACV/TCV).

  • Governance & compliance: Familiarity with public-sector procurement practices and export-control considerations; knows when to engage specialists.

  • Marketing savvy: Skilled in shaping and delivering impactful presentations, narratives, and proposals that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Soft skills: Executive presence, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, stakeholder influence, and resilience in long negotiations.

  • Ways of working: High ownership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment; willing to travel for customer meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience at a small satellite company that scaled into a large business - candidates who've operated through that growth curve are especially well suited to this role.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Commercial Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About us

At STRATOS Technologies, we are transforming how companies make data-driven decisions. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, enabling businesses to strengthen their long-term strategies through clear and actionable insights.

Our founders, former business and tech executives who led a $1B division at a Fortune 500 industrial company, originally built a digital twin of their enterprise to drive synchronized planning and execution. Seeing the market’s lack of such a system, they launched STRATOS in 2022 with a bold mission: to unifiy all internal and external data into a single platform.

Today, STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

From commercial AI agents to embedded intelligence that supercharges lean teams, STRATOS enables businesses to achieve 10x productivity and strengthen long-term strategies through actionable insights. We are now expanding our team to accelerate our growth even further and help our customers outperform their competition

The role. You own a piece of the relationship with one of our customers: their data, their questions, and whether the product answers them. You will do the analysis, present it to their commercial leadership, and take what you learn back to our engineers as something we should build. The difference from where you are now is that you stay with it. You see whether the recommendation worked, and when it doesn't, you're the one who fixes it.

The roles you'll play

  • Owner of a workstream — take a defined part of the deployment end to end: the market model, the target list or the scoring logic, from first data through to something the customer's teams use every week.

  • Advisor to the customer's commercial team — run working sessions with sales and commercial leadership, present your own analysis, and handle the challenge yourself. You are in the room, not behind it.

  • Co-owner of the account — you share the relationship with a senior CPM and take on more of it as the year goes on, up to running a customer of your own.

  • Voice of the customer in our roadmap — turn what you see in the field into what we build, and stay with it through the roadmap until it ships.

  • Builder of how we work — sharpen the standards, templates and tooling that make the next deployment better than the last.

Who this is for. Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or an analytical commercial role.

  • You have run a workstream yourself: not just the analysis, but the stakeholder who didn't want to give you the data and the deadline that moved.

  • You are quick in data and you check your own numbers. Excel and PowerPoint are assumed; any SQL or Python is a bonus, not a requirement, and we'll teach you what you need.

  • You can present to people twenty years your senior without either deferring to them or lecturing them.

  • You are curious about how industrial businesses actually work — how a building-materials group reaches its customers, why a distributor behaves the way it does.

  • You want more responsibility than your peers get, and you understand that comes with being the one who is wrong in public sometimes.

This probably isn't for you if you want to specialise early, or if you'd rather be handed a defined analysis than decide what the right question is.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company

  • A highly competitive salary

  • Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for

  • Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum

  • Private healthcare

  • Pension scheme

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays

  • Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time

  • Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

  • Travel to some customer sites around, mostly within Europe

  • German is genuinely useful here and several of our customers are German-speaking, but it is not a requirement

The process

  1. First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes

  1. Tehcncial case interview — 45 minutes

  1. Hiring manager interview with a senior executive - 30 minutes

  1. Second senior executive interview, which may include a case exercise - 30 minutes

  1. Final stage with our CEO - 45 minutes

title: Customer Director - Life Sciences
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratize health for all.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Life Sciences clients, helping them supercharge their operations and end-user engagement through AI-powered decision-making. Leading a high-performing team of delivery and engagement specialists, you’ll oversee complex commercial negotiations, ensure the successful delivery of cutting-edge Applied AI solutions, and build key relationships which position Faculty as the global leader in AI-driven transformation.

#LI-PRIO

What you'll be doing

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and onboarding new clients within your sector

  • Developing and implementing robust strategic account plans that align Faculty’s AI solutions with client business objectives

  • Leading commercial negotiations and partnering with the Business Unit Director on accurate sales planning and forecasting

  • Building trusted relationships with senior budget holders and C-suite stakeholders to ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention

  • Managing and mentoring cross-functional commercial teams

  • Representing Faculty at industry events and networking forums to build a reputation as a thought leader in AI-driven transformation

  • Collaborating with technical teams to translate complex data concepts into innovative use cases that solve real-world client problems

Who we're looking for

  • You’ve managed senior, complex stakeholder relationships in the Life Sciences industry - some experience in consulting preferred

  • You have experience leading large-scale AI/digital transformation projects

  • You possess a strong business development mindset with experience in sales methodologies and the end-to-end management of deal processes

  • You are a practical problem solver with the forensic skills to scope a problem, identify client needs and implement effective solutions

  • You are a compelling communicator - comfortable collaborating with technical experts and translating data-oriented concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • You bring experience in team mentorship and coaching

  • You have demonstrated capability to balance multiple strategic projects simultaneously, while maintaining a focus on quality and commercial impact

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen: 40 mins

  2. Introduction Interview: 60 mins

  3. Commercial Interview: 60 mins

  4. Leadership and Principles interview: 60 mins

  5. Meet the MD, Commercial: 30 mins

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You enjoy working at high velocity:
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

title: Customer Success Manager - Agriculture
descriptionHtml:
🌎 What we do

Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy.

📅 Over the next months, you will…

Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers

  • Own the success of a defined customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform

  • Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end, driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery

  • Design and run farmer-facing enablement, including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level

  • Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy

  • Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations.

🧺 What you bring along

  • Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives)

  • Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

  • First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end

  • People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind

  • Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency

  • Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus

  • Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week

The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning!

title: Data & AI Engineer, Digital Twin und Pricing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
HICONIUM baut die Pricing- und Handelsplattform für Sammlerfahrzeuge mit einem Wert von über einer Million US-Dollar. Zwei Dinge tragen alles, was wir tun: der Digital Twin, die vollständige und belegte digitale Akte jedes Fahrzeugs, und HICON-PRICE, eine exakte, mit Evidenz hinterlegte Zahl statt einer Spanne.

Für beides suchen wir die Person, die aus Serviceheften, Rechnungen, Zertifikaten, Herstellerdaten und Marktdaten saubere, geprüfte Daten macht und die Pipelines dafür selbst baut. Du arbeitest täglich mit unserem CTO und unserem Head of Research & Data Science, unterstützt beide und übernimmst einen Teilbereich in eigener Verantwortung.

Schweizer Vollzeitanstellung, hybrid mit Basis in Zürich und flexibler Zusammenarbeit. Wir suchen vorrangig in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich. Arbeitssprache Deutsch; Englisch für internationale Quellen und Kontakte.

Aufgaben

  • Dokumente zu Daten: Du baust die Pipeline, die hochgeladene Unterlagen (Fahrzeugausweise, Rechnungen, Servicehefte, Zertifikate, Kaufverträge) erkennt und in strukturierte Felder überführt; jedes Feld mit Evidenzgrad, Konfidenz und Verweis auf die Stelle im Dokument. Unsichere Fälle gehen in eine Prüfschleife, und du misst, wie oft die Pipeline falsch liegt.

  • Importe: Du entwickelst die Importe für Daten von Herstellern, Restauratoren, Werkstätten und Händlern (CSV, JSON, Schnittstellen), so dass jede Angabe ihre Herkunft behält.

  • Datenbasis für HICON-PRICE: Du führst Auktionsergebnisse, Händlerangebote und Fahrzeugakten zusammen, löst Dubletten und Fahrgestellnummern sauber auf und hältst Datenlecks aus den Modellen fern.

  • Vom Modell zum Produkt: Du stellst Modelle so bereit, dass eine Zahl mit ihrer Evidenz herauskommt, mit Versionierung, Backtests, Kalibrierung und Monitoring.

  • Analyse: Du beantwortest Fragen aus den Daten (Abdeckung, Qualität, Auffälligkeiten, Marktbewegungen) und machst die Antworten für Team, Händler und Sammler verständlich.

  • Verantwortung: Nach der Einarbeitung führst du einen Teilbereich fachlich selbst, zum Beispiel Ingestion und Datenqualität des Digital Twin.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Daten- oder ML-Pipelines gebaut, die produktiv laufen, und kannst erzählen, was kaputtging und wie du es behoben hast.

  • Sehr gutes Python und SQL; Erfahrung mit Dokumentenextraktion (OCR, Sprach- und Vision-Modelle) oder mit grossen, uneinheitlichen Datenquellen.

  • Du misst, bevor du behauptest: Fehlerquoten, Vergleich mit Referenzdaten, saubere Trennung von Trainings- und Testdaten.

  • Du verstehst Modelle gut genug, um Forschungsarbeit produktionsreif zu machen; forschen musst du nicht selbst.

  • Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit AI-Coding-Werkzeugen und prüfst deren Ergebnisse selbst; mit vertraulichen Daten gehst du bewusst um. Sicheres Arbeiten mit macOS gehört dazu: Wir setzen ausschliesslich Apple-Geräte ein.

  • Du arbeitest ohne fertiges Pflichtenheft, dokumentierst nachvollziehbar und meldest dich, bevor etwas hängt.

  • Deutsch und Englisch fliessend; Italienisch oder Französisch ist ein Plus.

  • Fahrzeugwissen ist kein Muss, echte Neugier darauf schon. Wer Sammlerfahrzeuge, Auktionen oder Herstellerdaten kennt, hat einen Vorsprung.

Benefits

  • Du arbeitest am Kernprodukt: Auf deiner Arbeit bauen Bewertung, Handel und alle Partneranbindungen auf.

  • Du arbeitest mit echten Fahrzeugen und echten Sammlungen und bekommst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, der mit dir wächst.

  • Schweizer Anstellung mit transparentem Fixgehalt und flexiblem Arbeiten im gemeinsam vereinbarten Modell.

  • 30 Ferientage bei einer Fünftagewoche sowie CHF 3’000 Weiterbildungsbudget und fünf Lerntage pro Jahr.

  • Zwei geschützte halbe Tage pro Woche für konzentrierte Arbeit. Du gestaltest Datenverfahren und Werkzeuge mit und arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Branchenexperten.

  • Du kannst geeignete Methodenbeiträge unter deinem Namen veröffentlichen. Benötigte Datenzugänge, Rechenleistung und Arbeitsmittel stellen wir im vereinbarten Projektbudget bereit. Unsere Arbeitsausstattung basiert ausschliesslich auf Apple-Geräten.

So läuft es ab: ein Videogespräch von 45 Minuten mit unserem Head of Research & Data Science; danach zwei bis drei bezahlte Probetage in Zürich an einer echten Aufgabe, unter Vertraulichkeitsvereinbarung; am letzten Tag stellst du dein Ergebnis Gründer und CTO vor, und der Entscheid folgt innert 48 Stunden. Nach der Bewerbung gibt es keine Hausaufgaben und kein Assessment-Center.

Bewirb dich über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Link zu Code oder zu einem Projekt, das läuft, sagt uns mehr. Im Formular fragen wir nur Startdatum, Gehaltsvorstellung und Sprachkenntnisse ab.

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in German and English

⭐ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

title: DevOps Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Helm or Datadog is a plus,

  • You speak English and ideally French.

title: Director of Field Operations (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role


You will own how Orbem shows up at customer sites — installing, servicing, and maintaining multi-million-euro imaging systems that sit at the heart of our customers’ production lines. When our systems run, our customers run. When they don’t, the cost is measured in lost production days. Field Operations is where our technology meets reality, and you own that interface.

Field Operations spans Europe and the US, with regional teams on both sides of the Atlantic. A lot has already been built: dedicated Field Engineers and Project Managers, regional leadership, and real investment in SOPs, planning, and tooling. The next step is maturity — turning what exists into an operation that runs consistently across every site, every partner, and every geography, and that scales without depending on individual heroics.

You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. This is a role for someone equally at home setting the operating model and being close to the work itself — credible with a customer's engineers and with our executive team on the same day — and who is unwilling to let the same problem happen twice.


Your Day to Day

Running Operations (≈ 40%)

  • Own end-to-end delivery of installations, on-site service, and scheduled maintenance across Europe and the US — on time, on budget, and at a quality level appropriate to assets worth more than €1M each.

  • Empower and enable Regional Leaders and Project Managers to flawlessly orchestrate complex site deliveries involving customers, MRI suppliers, and automation partners.

  • Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk.

  • Own the operational KPIs and the commitments we make to customers, and keep Technical Customer Support, Business Development, and the executive team informed.

 

Building the Operating System (≈ 35%)

  • Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors.

  • Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team.

  • Leverage and drive the tooling and data we need to run this at scale — field service management, installation and service documentation, spare parts and capacity planning — and make sure people actually use it.

  • Build the quality and safety standards our engineers work to, and hold the line on them under schedule pressure.

 

Leading and Scaling the Team (≈ 25%)

  • Lead and develop the whole team — Field Engineers, Project Managers, and regional leads alike — building the depth and ownership that lets each region run well without you in the detail.

  • Design the organisation ahead of the growth curve: hire, structure, and re-structure as we add verticals and geographies, and find the right mix of own team, partner networks, and variable capacity models to absorb fluctuating demand.

  • Define and operationalize the Field Operations roadmap, and translate it into a capacity and hiring plan the business can commit to.

  • Build the culture: high standards, low ego, no blame, and a bias toward fixing things properly.

How You Fit In

  • You report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead Field Operations through two regional team leads, with Field Engineers delivering installation, on-site service, and maintenance work and Project Managers coordinating customers, partners, and internal teams. The team will keep growing as we roll out new geographies and products.

  • You work closely with Technical Customer Support, Operational Excellence, Supply Chain, Hardware, Product, and Business Development, and you own our operational relationship with our equipment and automation partners.

  • You are part of the wider operations leadership team and contribute to decisions well beyond your own function.


Your Experiences and Skills

  • 10+ years in field or service operations. You have led installation, on-site service, and maintenance operations for complex technical products.

  • Hardware plus service business models. You understand a business where the machine is only half the promise and installation, uptime, and maintenance are the other half.

  • Experience at operational scale. You have worked inside an organisation that had already solved this properly — mature SOPs, field service tooling, quality processes, clear team structures — and you know what “good” actually looks like, not just in theory.

  • Multi-region leadership. You have built and led geographically distributed teams and developed team leads into strong operational leaders.

  • Hands-on and strategic. You can design the operating model and the roadmap, and you will also get on a plane and stand on a site on short notice when the situation calls for it.

  • Continuous improvement as a reflex. You see every error as an opportunity and an obligation to be better next time, and you have the methods to back that up.

  • Technical fluency. You can engage credibly on site planning, requirement specifications, and installation and commissioning detail, and hold your own with engineers, suppliers, and customers’ technical teams.

  • Drive and proactiveness. You move before being asked, chase ambiguity down rather than escalating it up, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Senior communicator. You build trust with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, and you can deliver difficult messages without damaging the relationship.

  • Practicalities. Willingness to travel to European and US sites, and an EU Class B driver’s licence. Fluent in English; additional languages (German, Spanish, Italian, French) are a plus.


What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience in a venture-capital-backed, private-equity-backed or similarly execution-driven environment, where operational discipline, cost, and delivery commitments were tracked seriously.

  • You have taken a field operations function through a step change in scale — doubling geographies, product lines, or installed base — and can describe what broke and what you did about it.

  • Formal continuous improvement or quality credentials (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent) that you have actually applied to a service organisation.

  • Hands-on experience implementing field service management or service data tooling, including getting a team to adopt it.

  • Experience in a high-growth deep-tech or capital-equipment company, where the product was still changing underneath the operation.

  • You are obsessed with customer experience and can point to the operational choices you made to protect it.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club, Wellhub or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

title: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access
descriptionHtml:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

Revolutionizing access to medical treatments

We're on a mission to enable earlier and better access to treatments and improve the lives of patients. Making it possible for anyone to find and access the best possible treatment options, with the click of a button. Bringing together demand and supply like never before, in one of the world's largest industries. Our patient-centered offering is gaining traction, and with the right team we can go from helping thousands of patients each year, to millions of patients. Do you aspire to be at the forefront of innovation in healthcare and creating the next health tech unicorn? You’ve come to the right place!

The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access

As the Director of Pharma Partnerships, Expanded Access, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with BioPharmaceutical companies for myTomorrows' Expanded Access Program (EAP) solutions, with a focus on global sustainble acess. You will be responsible for generating leads, establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives, and growing the number of chargeable expanded access programs (named patient sales) we run for our partners.

Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset, market access and expanded access experience, and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, strategic partnership development and closing high-value, multi-year deals. A clear approach to target key account and ideal customer profiles will be key.

You will be directly accountable for qualifying deals and delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, with a clear path to measurable growth and market expansion.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, regulatory developments and competitor activities. You do this in close collaboration with our EAP operations, global access, marketing and revenue operations teams, as part of the Expanded Access business unit.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidatesin North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.

What you'll do in this role

  • Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a Pharma Partnerships Associate.

  • Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners for chargeable EAPs and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Drive revenue growth by meeting and exceeding partnership targets and sales quotas.

  • Qualify deals, negotiate agreements and close multi-year EAP partnerships that align with company objectives.

  • Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets, with clear accountability for pipeline conversion and deal velocity.

  • Together with our Director, Expanded Access Strategy and Director, Global Access, build the case for chargeable programs with BioPharma clients: identify the countries and pathways where charging for treatment is allowed, and design pricing, country selection, regulatory approach and supply model to match.

  • Lead proposals and bid defenses together with EA strategy and Global Access and finance, so every offer is commercially sound and deliverable.

  • Collaborate closely with EAP Operations and Global Access to ensure a smooth handover and the successful implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, such as moving free-of-charge programs to a chargeble model, additional countries, assets, post-trial access, real-world data and patient recruitment, and support contracting for these expansions.

  • Support the development of sales enablement material, working closely with product marketing.

  • Act as a thought leader in Expanded Access, strengthening myTomorrows' external positioning through industry presence, conference talks and high-quality content.

  • Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory developments and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.

  • Travel to clients, conferences and prospects across the globe (up to 60% of the time).

What you bring to the table

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Life Science or Healthcare (Bachelor's degree considered with strong experience).

  • 5+ years of experience in partnership development, business development or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry.

  • An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within medical affairs, market access, regulatory affairs and the Expanded Access space.

  • Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

  • Strong understanding of Expanded Access, Named Patient Sales pricing and reimbursement, and the regulatory frameworks for Expanded Access in Europe and other key markets.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

  • The ability to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans.

  • An AI-first way of working. You use AI tools daily to research, verify and document faster, and you are always looking for ways to do more with less, without compromising on accuracy.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

If this sounds like your next move, we'd love to hear from you.

Patsnap is seeking a commercially minded, technically capable leader to manage and develop our global Solutions Consulting team, supporting all products supporting Patsnap's portfolio across Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, Materials Science and Engineering.

As we expand our AI capabilities, our approach to Solutions Consulting is evolving. Beyond traditional product demonstrations and technical evaluations, we're increasingly helping customers integrate Patsnap's intelligence, AI agents and data directly into their existing systems and business workflows.

You'll lead an established global team of Solutions Consultants, strengthening its technical capabilities and expanding the function through the introduction of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). We're looking for someone who brings substantial experience leading customer-facing technical teams, alongside the technical depth to challenge, guide and contribute to solution development. Want to see the platform you'd be representing?

Global Team Leadership & Development

AI, MCP & Data Solution Delivery

title: Director, Quality & Release Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Location: London or Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Director

Team: Quality & Release

Salary: £150,000 - £180,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: VP Engineering

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work inthe UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

The quality engineering function is shifting  from manual oversight and process governance toward an AI-assisted product development lifecycle where QA leads its own domain test strategy and bespoke tooling drives automation maturity.  This role will drive this shift in our organization and ways of working. 

You will own quality and release governance at programme level, directly manage an engineering team building AI-assisted automation and test data capability, and set the standard that QA leads across delivery streams work to. You will be as comfortable driving change as you are accountable for outcomes. Responsibilities will include:

Strategic Quality Leadership

  • Own and evolve the quality strategy across delivery streams, aligned to programme objectives and client SLAs

  • Define and maintain release governance frameworks — release readiness criteria, risk acceptance, and sign-off authorities

  • Set quality standards and coverage expectations; ensure QA leads translate these into domain-level test strategies

  • Drive defect governance at programme level — internal and client-facing SLA compliance

  • Represent quality and risk in senior leadership, architecture, and product forums

AI-Driven Tooling & Automation

  • Directly manage a team of engineers building and maintaining bespoke automation tooling, leveraging AI and LLM capabilities

  • Own the test data management strategy — including AI-assisted synthetic data generation and environment data integrity

  • Evaluate and select off-the-shelf AI testing tools; define governance frameworks for their use and validation

  • Ensure governance gates are maintained as AI participation in the PDLC grows — accountable humans must remain in the loop for risk acceptance and production judgement

  • Establish tooling standards that QA leads can adopt across domains without creating dependency on a central bottleneck

QA Function Leadership & Operating Model

  • Lead, develop, and performance-manage QA leads embedded across domains; define the operating model and career framework for the function

  • Own the accountability split clearly: QA leads own test strategy and tooling choices for their domain; this role owns the standard they work to

  • Drive consistency across streams without becoming a handoff point — enable QA leads to move fast within well-defined guardrails

  • Build a quality engineering culture — not a bug-finding one

Change Management & Adoption

  • Lead the transformation of QA practice from script maintenance to intelligent, risk-based, AI-assisted quality engineering

  • Drive upskilling across the function — building capability in AI tooling, context engineering, and agent-assisted workflows

  • Manage resistance and build confidence in new ways of working; bring the team through change without losing them

  • Communicate quality outcomes in business terms to senior stakeholders — escaped defect rates, release stability, risk posture

Release Management

  • Own the release quality process end-to-end: environment strategy, regression coverage, go/no-go decisions, and post-release monitoring

  • Embed shift-left practices — quality gates early in the PDLC, not just at release

  • Manage the tension between delivery velocity and release stability, particularly as AI-generated code volumes increase


What you’ll bring
Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven track record leading a QA or quality engineering function of significant scale — including embedded domain leads and direct management of practitioners

  • Has directly managed engineers building tooling or automation infrastructure — not just managed QA practitioners executing test plans

  • Has delivered a meaningful QA transformation: AI adoption, automation maturity uplift, defect governance overhaul, or similar

  • Has worked in a multi-client or multi-product platform environment, managing quality outcomes across concurrent delivery streams

  • Has owned release governance in a complex, multi-stream delivery context — including go/no-go accountability

  • Exposure to energy, utilities, billing, or similarly regulated complex domains is a plus — not essential
    Strong grounding in test strategy, automation frameworks, and CI/CD integration — sufficient to credibly lead engineers building these things

  • Working knowledge of LLMs and AI tooling in a QA context: test generation, defect triage, coverage analysis, synthetic test data

  • Understands test data management principles and the challenges of environment data integrity at scale

  • Able to evaluate build vs. buy for tooling; assess AI testing platforms with appropriate scepticism
    Comfortable setting strategy and being accountable for outcomes — not just owning process

  • Able to operate at programme level with senior engineering and product stakeholders

  • Experienced in leading distributed, multi-timezone quality functions

  • Strong communicator — translates quality metrics into business outcomes; can make the case for investment in tooling and governance
    Demonstrated experience leading practice transformation in an engineering context

  • Able to bring people with them through transitions that challenge established ways of working

  • Comfortable with ambiguity; can hold direction steady while the detail is still being worked out

  • Familiar with observability, production monitoring, and shift-right quality practices


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Director, Regulatory Compliance UK
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

We hire builders with founder-level energy—people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do.

As Director, Regulatory Compliance (UK), you will serve as the senior compliance authority and strategic partner for Airwallex’s rapidly expanding UK presence. Operating as a licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) supervised by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Airwallex requires compliance leadership that sees regulatory integrity not as a roadblock, but as a critical commercial enabler and competitive differentiator.

In this role, you will lead our UK compliance framework, serve as the primary interface with local regulators and industry bodies, and work cross-functionally across Product, Strategy, Commercial, and Operations to safely launch cutting-edge payment infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UK Regulatory Compliance: Lead a UK-based team of regulatory compliance professionals; own and continuously evolve the UK compliance management system, policies, registers, and operational controls to ensure ongoing compliance with FCA handbooks, PSRs, EMRs, and UK AML/CTF regimes.

  • Drive FCA Engagement: Act as the principal point of contact for the FCA, handling regulatory inquiries, notifications, audits, thematic reviews, and routine reporting with transparency and authority.

  • Product & Commercial Advisory: Partner early with Product, Commercial, and International Expansion teams to design compliant-by-default cross-border payment, issuing, acquiring, and embedded finance architectures.

  • Safeguarding & Governance: Oversee compliance aspects of key UK regulatory regimes including safeguardingand Consumer Duty in close partnership with Finance, Risk, Product, and other teams.

  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Monitor domestic and international regulatory developments (e.g., Consumer Duty, operational resilience, PSR APP fraud reimbursement schemes) and proactively translate emerging rules into pragmatic technical and operational roadmaps.

  • Team Leadership & Culture: Build, coach, and scale a high-caliber UK compliance advisory and operations team while fostering a company-wide culture of risk accountability and ethical rigor.

  • Board & Committee Reporting: Prepare and deliver clear, actionable regulatory compliance reporting and key risk indicator (KRI) updates to executive leadership, local operating boards, and audit/risk committees.

What We’re Looking For

Essentials

  • 10+ years of regulatory compliance experience within UK fintech, payment services (EMIs/APIs), neo-banking, or modern global financial institutions.

  • Leadership Track Record: At least 4+ years managing and developing high-performing compliance teams in high-growth environments.

  • Deep Regulatory Knowledge: Expert grasp of UK financial regulations, including the Payment Services Regulations (PSRs), Electronic Money Regulations (EMRs), FCA Principles for Businesses, and Consumer Duty standards.

  • FCA Interface Experience: Direct track record of managing formal regulator relationships, supervisory inspections, or key authorization filings with the FCA.

  • Pragmatic Problem-Solving: Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements through a first-principles lens, providing creative, commercial, and defensible paths forward.

  • Executive Presence: Strong communication, negotiation, and written advocacy skills capable of influencing board members, executive partners, and external regulatory bodies.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Prior experience holding an approved person / Senior Management Function (SMF) role under the FCA regime.

  • Background handling regulatory aspects of cross-border multi-currency schemes, merchant acquiring, or credit/lending adjacencies.

  • Relevant legal qualification or industry certifications (e.g., ICA Diploma in Governance, Risk & Compliance).

You’ll Thrive Here If

  • You own the outcome: You don't wait for permission to solve structural bottlenecks—give you a complex regulatory challenge, and you chart the solution.

  • You’re commercially astute: You understand that compliance is an enabler of sustainable hyper-growth, not an isolated checklist.

  • You balance technical precision with plain-English clarity: You can dissect statutory instruments line by line, then distill the essence clearly for engineers, sales leads, and executives.

  • You’re not precious about traditional playbooks: You push hard from first principles, challenging legacy banking compliance norms with modernized, technology-driven solutions.

  • You value in-person collaboration: You thrive working shoulder-to-shoulder with cross-functional leaders in our London hub.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete a comprehensive assessment of our existing UK compliance controls, policies, and FCA commitments; build alignment with key UK commercial leads and partner banks.

  • Within 6 Months: Streamline product approval compliance workflows; enhance local risk governance reporting; and lead strategic readiness for any pending UK regulatory changes.

  • Within 12 Months: Institutionalize a top-tier UK compliance function that scales seamlessly with transaction volume and new market offerings while maintaining an immaculate standing with the FCA.

Why Join Airwallex

  • Competitive base salary, performance incentives, and meaningful equity.

  • High autonomy to build, scale, and influence the core infrastructure powering the global digital economy.

  • Comprehensive health, wellness, pension, and parental leave coverage.

  • Dynamic, global culture with clear paths for rapid professional development.

Equal Opportunity
