descriptionHtml:
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Site Engineer to look after our growing estate across the North of England and Scotland.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Site Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure across the North of England and Scotland, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work.

Location & Travel

This is a field-based role covering our northern estate, from Leeds up to Scotland. The ideal candidate will be based between Leeds and Dundee, and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our northern locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment.

  • RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site.

  • Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards.

  • Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally.

  • Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment.

  • Site visits: Visit sites across the North of England and Scotland on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks.

  • Proactive monitoring: Plan and execute regular site visits and maintenance schedules across the northern estate to maintain a high-quality estate.

  • Subcontractor coordination: Coordinate subcontractors on site to ensure maintenance and project work is delivered on time.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Background in hands-on installation, ideally from companies or industries such as Sky, CCTV, BT, Field IT or IoT-related roles. (ANPR experience is beneficial but not required.)

  • Experience working with subcontractors to ensure projects meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently, making on-the-spot decisions to meet project objectives.

  • Experience producing site documentation, such as site maps and install plans.

  • Comfortable working alone, following installation plans and survey documents.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt to dynamic site conditions.

  • Based between Leeds and Dundee, and able to travel regularly across all of our sites in the North of England and Scotland.

  • Full, clean UK driving licence (essential).

  • Basic knowledge of Risk Assessments and RAMS documentation.

Desirable Qualifications / Certificates

  • Asbestos Awareness

  • Abrasive Wheels Certification

  • Working at Height Certification

  • Ladder Safety Training

  • Health & Safety Awareness

  • C&G 2365 (Electrical Installation)

  • CAT & Genny Training

  • IPAF (Powered Access Equipment)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary & benefits: Reflective of your experience and designed to support your professional growth and well-being.

  • Company van for site travel.

  • Company pension, sick pay and on-site parking.

  • Flexible, home-based working: Split your time between home and our sites across the North of England and Scotland.

Why Hozah?

At Hozah, you'll play a pivotal role in a purpose-driven company at the forefront of urban mobility innovation. We foster a culture of collaboration, creativity and positive impact, where your contributions help shape the future of smarter cities. If you're looking to make a real difference in transforming the future of mobility, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be part of this exciting journey!

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. title: Sales Lead - Enterprise - Healthcare
descriptionHtml:

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

About the role

As Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare, you’ll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run.

In regulated industries, relationships are the currency, so we’re looking for a leader who already knows the buyers and the rulebook. You’ll have the mandate to win net-new logos, drive agent sales, and build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive adoption of ElevenLabs, including closing deals yourself and also building and scaling the team

  • Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

  • Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

  • Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

  • Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 2 years leading a team.

  • Track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • An established network of senior decision-makers in one or more of health systems, payers, or life sciences, so you can name the buyers you’d call in your first 30 days

title: Senior Design Engineer | Deel
descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product and design-system contributors. You complement engineering and do not replace it.

  • Keep the system round-tripping to shared surfaces such as Figma. AI-accelerated output stays visible and open to feedback, never a black box.

Push into generative UI

  • Take AI beyond the build process and into the product itself.

  • Prototype and evaluate adaptive, AI-generated interfaces as a product capability, and help decide where they belong on the roadmap.

Level up the team

  • Turn what works into playbooks, prompt libraries and enablement. The wider design org builds on the system and does not depend on you. The goal is durable capability, not tool dependency.

What you need to succeed:

  • You move fluidly between design and code. You don't need to be the deepest specialist in either. You can design something well, build it yourself, and use AI to move quickly between the two.

  • You have real taste for layout, typography, interaction and motion, and you care about polish.

  • You are comfortable writing TypeScript and React, including HTML, CSS and animation. You prototype fast and get from idea to working interface in hours rather than days, moving between Figma and code.

  • You have built or extended design systems that others rely on.

  • You already use AI design and coding tools in real work, and you want to help shape new ones.

  • You have 7+ years in product design and front-end engineering on complex products. You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you set standards others follow.

What you get:

  • Stock grant opportunities, depending on your role, employment status and location.

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country.

  • Optional flexible working office membership with IWG.

title: Senior Sales Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

About the Role:

As a Sales Engineer, it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

Please note that this role covers the DACH region and Israel.

What you'll be doing:

In this role you will:

  • Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  4. Language Proficiency:

  5. Travel Flexibility:
     Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration. In this role we will ask you to cover DACH and Israel.

As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.
  • Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives 
  • Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems 
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted
  • Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are: 

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences 
  • Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates
  • A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it 
  • Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious 
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Search & AI
descriptionHtml:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

We’re looking for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Software Engineer, Search & AI to join our growing team.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help build and evolve the customer-facing search experiences that help users discover relevant, high-quality content, along with the backend systems that power them. You’ll work across the stack, with a slight emphasis on frontend development, and collaborate closely with engineers, Product, and Design to deliver intuitive search experiences backed by reliable, scalable search and data systems.

What You'll Do

  • Own and deliver customer-facing search features and workflows across frontend and backend systems, from technical planning through production
  • Build AI-powered product experiences end to end, from the services behind them to the interfaces that make their output useful and trustworthy
  • Build intuitive, responsive user experiences using Vue while contributing to the Python and Django services that power them
  • Design and improve search, indexing, and retrieval systems that support high-quality content discovery across large volumes of data
  • Build and maintain features and data workflows that leverage technologies such as Elasticsearch, Kafka, Celery, and MySQL
  • Make thoughtful technical decisions and trade-offs that balance customer experience, delivery speed, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and engineering teammates to shape solutions, clarify requirements, and deliver high-quality customer experiences
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive improvements to the performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability of the systems you work on
  • Participate in an on-call and incident response rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues and improve system reliability over time

To Be Set Up for Success in This Role, You'll Need to Have

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production software
  • Strong experience working across frontend and backend systems and independently delivering features throughout the application stack
  • Proficiency with Python or a similar programming language and experience with Django or a comparable web framework
  • Experience building polished, maintainable user-facing applications with Vue.js or another modern JavaScript framework
  • Experience with Elasticsearch or a comparable search technology, or significant experience working with data-intensive systems
  • Experience making technical trade-offs within complex production systems while balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term quality
  • Experience diagnosing production issues and contributing to the reliability and operational health of the systems you build
  • Experience with TypeScript in a large codebase
  • Experience with design systems or shared component libraries
  • Flexibility to adjust working hours for overlap with teammates in US time zones

If Any of the Below Also Describe You, This Could Be an Exciting Opportunity

  • Experience with Kafka or other streaming or event-driven technologies
  • Experience with MySQL, Postgres, or other relational databases
  • Experience with Celery or other asynchronous task-processing systems
  • Experience building search, discovery, indexing, or information-retrieval features
  • Experience improving frontend architecture, performance, or complex customer-facing workflows
  • Experience working with high-traffic SaaS applications or systems that process large volumes of data
  • Experience building customer-facing features backed by LLMs or other AI models
  • Experience judging whether an AI-backed feature is actually working, through evaluation, testing, or user feedback
  • Interest in journalism, news, media, or social media

In Addition, We're Always Looking for Candidates Who

  • Communicate complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners
  • Take ownership of problems and drive work forward independently while knowing when to involve others
  • Take pride in building readable, testable, maintainable software while making pragmatic technical trade-offs
  • Approach ambiguous or complex problems thoughtfully and use sound judgment to identify effective solutions
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture through thoughtful code reviews, knowledge sharing, feedback, and continuous improvement
  • Proactively incorporates AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery

title: Senior TechOps Architect
descriptionHtml:
We’re really excited to be building a small, thoughtful and effective TechOps team at Octopus. We’re looking for a knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Architect to help shape how we support people across the business - someone who can lead with clarity, build with empathy, and bring a mix of technical depth and sound judgment. There’s loads to get stuck into, from identity management and scripting to device management and scalable tooling, areas where most of our work sits and where we need thoughtful, sustainable solutions. You’ll play an important role in shaping how we work: setting direction without overcomplicating things, supporting the team with care, and balancing technical curiosity with a down-to-earth mindset. We’re after someone who can spot where things could be better, help others grow, and make improvements that stick. If you’re excited about solving meaningful problems and shaping how TechOps supports a growing, people-first business – we’d love to chat. What is TechOps? A more modern, more lean version of a traditional enterprise IT team. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between. We focus on advising rather than enforcing, and give people the autonomy to work with technology to solve their problems in the way that works best for them. We’re an autonomous team who look after a wide range of technology across the business. We empower teams to do the best work they can whilst keeping things running efficiently in the background. We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company. We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here! About the role As a TechOps Architect, You will be responsible for high-level strategic and architectural technical decisions around the business. We also strongly believe that no matter what role you have within TechOps, it’s still important to keep your ear to the ground and see, first hand, the problems our users are facing, and the impact that decisions you make have on everyone at Octopus. This means you’ll spend some of your time helping out with day-to-day “1st, 2nd and 3rd line” support. You’ll have a wide breadth of knowledge and experience across all areas of IT, but also an immensely deep understanding of many of those areas too. You’ll likely be an acknowledged expert among your peers in Identity and Access Management, and have a passion for hacking and building. You will have interest and/or experience in related areas like software engineering, security, platform architecture, UI/UX design etc. Roles that you might currently be in: IAM Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead/Senior Support Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Systems Architect, Systems Designer, Senior Systems Engineer, Workplace Technology Architect, Solutions Architect.
What you'll do...
  • Define what good looks like for a small and lean TechOps team.
  • Tackle some of the toughest technical issues as we scale to tens of thousands of people.
  • Make wide-scale strategic technical decisions across the whole Octopus Energy Group, globally.
  • Design, build and continually improve processes, automations and systems that will improve user experience, remove inefficiencies, allow us to scale quickly and keep our team small.
  • Mentor the wider TechOps team, providing support and guidance for any technical project they may be working on. (This role will not involve directly managing people).
  • Support the rest of the team in providing delightful day-to-day technical support to all areas of the business, to ensure our incredible employees are able to do their job as efficiently as possible. Their problems are our problems.
  • Collaborate closely with our Security team to ensure we strike the right balance between security, productivity and user experience.
  • Managing supplier relationships and the procurement process for SaaS and hardware.
  • Lead and manage complex technical projects with multiple stakeholders from around the business.
    • Examples of some TechOps projects include…
  • Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider mac OS and Windows MDM migration
  • Rollout of a new device trust and posture compliance solution
  • The replacement of insecure factors like SMS with phishing-resistant factors
  • Office fit-outs, including tech like network infrastructure, AV and access control SaaS migrations for acquisitions, including Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace

    • What you'll need...
  • Experience leading on a range of technical projects across various technologies and platforms.
  • Experience with scripting, using APIs and automating mundane, error-prone repetitive tasks.
  • To be comfortable with a huge amount of ambiguity and spinning a lot of plates all at the same time.
  • Experience working with multiple teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting, managing and deploying applications to macOS, Windows, iOS and Android devices.
  • Understanding at the API level of Mobile Device Management systems and principles.
  • Experience with modern Identity & Access Management systems, including Okta, Microsoft Entra, JumpCloud, PingIdentity.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Single Sign-On (SSO) technologies such as OAuth, OIDC and SAML and Identity provisioning technologies such as SCIM.
  • Understanding at a protocol level of Single Sign-On (SSO) and identity provisioning technologies such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML and SCIM
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical, senior stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring less experienced team members.
  • A conscientious approach to everything you do and a passion for doing the right thing rather than the easy thing.
  • Strong opinions on best practice and you challenge traditional norms, advocating for more modern, novel approaches.
    • Should have:
  • Experience with email gateway administration and email routing.
  • Understanding of email security protocols and standards e.g. SPF, DKIM, DMARC etc.
  • Experience using git and GitHub for code changes and CI/CD.
  • Experience with Munki and AutoPkg for macOS software deployment
  • Experience with Chocolatey and PowerShell for Windows software deployment
  • A foundational understanding of programming and software engineering.
  • Experience integrating different identity providers
    • Nice to have:
  • Familiarity with frontend and backend engineering, including languages such as TypeScript and Python, and frameworks such as React, Remix and Django.
  • Familiarity with our security tooling - CrowdStrike EDR, Kolide, osquery, Zscaler
    • Don’t think you check off all of the above? We love hiring passionate people with a drive to learn so get in touch and let us know which areas you don’t currently have confidence and/or experience with, we’d love to hear from you!
    Why else you'll love it here 💚:
  • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
  • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We won best company to work for in 2022, on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022 and our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
  • 🎁 Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
    • If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic! Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

title: Technical & Solution Architect (Distributed Ledger / Regulated Financial Services)
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Technical & Solution Architect (Distributed Ledger / Regulated Financial Services)

Location: Hybrid - remote + regular on-site (London)

This is a hands-on technical leadership position in the making.

You will work across product management, engineering, and client-facing discussions to document and evolve the design of a distributed ledger-based post-trade platform operating within regulated financial services. You will initially contribute as our technical documentation lead while progressively taking ownership of system-level architecture, solution design, and technical direction.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to: Move from senior technical writer or senior engineer to architect; Work on real financial market infrastructure problems; Combine deep technical thinking with business context; Shape a product at an early stage.

Why join us? You'll have real ownership and influence in a small, high-calibre team, with direct exposure to cutting-edge financial market infrastructure and a genuine say in product and architectural direction. The role offers a steep learning curve spanning technology, regulation, and market structure, along with a clear path to grow into a formal Technical & Solution Architect position.


Responsibilities:

Technical Documentation:

  • Maintain and improve our existing documentation framework

  • Produce and maintain technical documentation for the core product:

    How its business capabilities have been implemented

    How it can be deployed and operated by our clients

    How it should evolve to meet new business requirements

Architecture & System Design:

  • Design scalable and secure distributed solutions in regulated environments

  • Define and evolve system architecture, APIs, and integration patterns

  • Apply appropriate software design patterns and architectural principles

  • Contribute to product hosting and capacity planning decisions

  • Ensure auditability, resilience, and operational robustness

Distributed Ledger & Digital Assets:

  • Work with distributed ledger technologies and smart contracts. Design models for:

  • Tokenised assets

  • Natively digital assets

  • Atomic settlement

  • DvP and RvP mechanisms

  • Central bank digital currency (CBDC) integration concepts

  • Evaluate trade-offs between on-chain and off-chain components

Financial Services Context:

  • Translate regulatory and market structure requirements into technical documentation and design

  • Understand settlement models and post-trade infrastructure

  • Work within business frameworks such as CSDR and GDPR

Communication & Influence

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, product management, clients, and regulators (where applicable)

  • Tailor messaging to different audiences.

  • Use structured thinking and persuasive communication to amplify the impact of our technology

  • Contribute to technical documentation and client materials

Requirements:

Technical:

  • Strong experience designing and documenting software products

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems principles

  • Familiarity with tokenisation and digital asset concepts

  • Good understanding of API design (REST, event-driven architectures, etc.)

Financial Services Knowledge (or strong motivation to learn):

  • Understanding of post-trade processes

  • Familiarity with: CSDR; Central securities depositories; DvP and RvP models; Atomic settlement

  • Appreciation of regulatory constraints in financial infrastructure

Communication & Leadership Potential:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Ability to adjust technical depth depending on audience

  • Structured and persuasive thinking

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity

  • Ambition to grow into a Technical & Solution Architect role

  • Ownership mindset and startup resilience

What Success Looks Like:

Within 6–12 months, success in this role means closing technical documentation gaps, owning key architectural decisions, and leading solution design discussions both internally and with partners. You'll be the go-to person for system-level trade-offs, using your technical insight to influence and document product direction, and you'll act as the bridge between business requirements and engineering implementation.

How We Work:

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please inform us.

This is a permanent full-time position. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks.

Who We Are:

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating service.

title: Research Engineer / Scientist, Data & Evals
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

  • Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

  • Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

  • Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

  • Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

  • Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

What You Have

  • Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

  • A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

  • The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

  • Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

title: Responsable du Développement Commercial (Sécurité Incendie Commerciale)
descriptionHtml:
Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie, à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation. L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs.

Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché. L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d'Ajax Systems. L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d'Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication. Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.

L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax.

title: Reward Lead (Part-Time, 2 Days a Week, Permanent)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

This is a permanent, part-time role, working two days a week. Unity is a scaling business with strong reward foundations already in place. We now need a senior reward specialist to strengthen them, fill the gaps and shape them into a framework that grows with the firm. We want reward that reflects how Unity actually works: Partner-led client teams, Functional Leader-led enablement teams, and a culture built on trust, direct feedback and progress over process. We don’t want a generic framework lifted from a larger, more traditional firm.

You’ll take what we have, judge what’s working and what isn’t, and build it out where it needs to go next. You’ll also run it: pay reviews, benefits renewals, and the data and reporting that keep it trusted. You’ll refine it each cycle and make sure the framework is well documented and easy for others to work with.

It suits someone who gets energy from building and improving, and who knows that reward only proves itself once it’s live. You’ll be comfortable with ambiguity and confident making judgement calls. You’ll respect what’s already been done while being willing to challenge it. You’ll also take satisfaction in the steady work of keeping a system accurate, fair and well-run.

This is a role where one expert can own reward end to end, without needing a full-time seat. It will suit an experienced reward specialist who wants a senior, high-impact role with a bounded commitment, including people with a fractional or portfolio background who now want a permanent home.


What you’ll own

  • Reward strategy and philosophy: build on and evolve Unity’s approach to pay. That covers how we position against the market, how pay works across client-facing and enablement tracks, and how reward reinforces Unity’s “progress over process” culture rather than working against it.

  • Pay structure and benchmarking: develop and maintain salary bands and grading across roles and levels, benchmarked against relevant professional services and advisory market data.

  • Pay review cycles: design and run the annual (or biannual) pay and bonus review. That includes timelines, guidance for Partners and Functional Leaders, calibration support, and sign-off with the Management Team / Partners Group.

  • Benefits: own the benefits offering end to end, including provider relationships, renewals, flexible benefits design and clear communication of value to employees.

  • Pay equity and compliance: run regular pay equity analysis (including gender pay gap reporting where applicable), keep Unity compliant with UK reward-related employment law, and flag risk to the CPO early.

  • Reward governance and data: keep reward data accurate and current in our people systems, and produce clear reporting for the Management Team on pay spend, equity and market position.

  • Advisory support: partner directly with Partners and Functional Leaders on individual pay decisions, such as new hire offers, promotions and retention cases. Your recommendations will be clear, defensible and grounded in the framework, not one-off improvisation.

  • The future of reward at Unity: work with the CPO to shape how reward evolves as the firm grows, including the capability, capacity and structure we’ll need over time.


What success looks like in your first 12 months

  • A refined, published pay and grading framework that Partners and Functional Leaders trust and actually use

  • A clean, well-governed annual pay review with no surprises for the Management Team

  • Reward decisions that are consistent, benchmarked and easy to explain, in keeping with Unity’s “trust and accountability” and “no surprises” principles

  • Reward documented and embedded, so that the framework is understood, easy to work with and keeps improving with each cycle


What we’re looking for

  • Senior reward / compensation and benefits experience, ideally including time in professional services, consulting or another partnership-style environment

  • Equally at home developing and extending an existing framework and running it well day to day, from benchmarking data and banding mechanics to benefits contracts and review timelines

  • Someone who sees the operational side of reward as part of the craft. Each pay cycle, renewal and equity report is a chance to test and improve the framework.

  • A pragmatic operator who can deliver across the full scope of reward in two focused days a week, prioritising the highest-leverage work first

  • Confident advising Partners and senior leaders directly, with recommendations grounded in evidence rather than precedent alone

  • Comfortable working with light process and high trust, building just enough structure and no more

  • Experience of part-time, interim or fractional working is welcome, but not required. We value people who can make an impact quickly and build things that last.


How this role fits at Unity

You’ll sit in the People Team, working closely with the Chief People Officer, the Performance Lead (a fellow part-time specialist), People Ops, and Partners and Functional Leaders across the business. Reward decisions at Unity draw on the same “collective insight, direct feedback” approach that runs through how the firm manages performance and probation. They’re calibrated and evidence-based, never made in isolation.


Additional information

We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview.

We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.


About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today’s CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

Akur8 works with customers across multiple entities, currencies and billing processes. This role ensures that signed contracts are accurately reflected in our systems, invoices are issued on time and payment issues are followed up efficiently.

You will work at the intersection of Finance, Sales Ops and our customers. You will also play an important role in improving the Salesforce to Maxio process, replacing manual checks with automated controls and making contract and billing data more reliable for the Finance team.

You will join Akur8’s Finance team and own the process from contract signature to payment collection. Your scope will cover all entities and currencies, including new contracts, renewals, upsells, amendments and terminations. You will register each signed contract in Salesforce, create the corresponding customer and contract in Maxio, issue invoices and follow up on outstanding payments.

You will work closely with Sales Ops on contract information and with customers, procurement teams and accounting departments on invoicing and payment follow-up. Accounting activities such as recording cash receipts and revenue recognition are outside the scope of this role.

This will include, but not be limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Reviewing signed contracts and amendments, comparing them with the information recorded in Salesforce and identifying specific cases such as prorated contracts, in-period upsells and terminations.

  • Creating customers and contracts in Maxio, including the identifiers required for electronic invoicing.

  • Issuing invoices and credit notes in Maxio and uploading them to customer portals such as Coupa and Ariba when required.

  • Reviewing automated annual indexation results, handling exceptions such as inflation caps or specific contractual clauses and ensuring updated values are reflected in Salesforce.

  • Contacting customers with overdue invoices and working with their accounting and procurement teams on purchase orders, portals and disputes.

  • Sharing payment delays with Sales Ops, supporting follow-up with the relevant sales teams and helping address the underlying causes.

  • Tracking the monthly accounts receivable ageing report, overdue balances and DSO.

  • Acting as the Finance point of contact for Salesforce data-entry rules, Salesforce to Maxio integration testing and recurring data discrepancies.

  • Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated with Claude and other team tools, then supporting their implementation through to production.

  • Helping ensure that Maxio reports are reliable for FP&A forecasting, budgeting and financial models.

This role is based in our Paris office.

EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

title: Sales Mitarbeiter – Teilzeit / Werkstudent
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Mission

Wir bei DeWarmte sind davon überzeugt, dass die Energiewende nur dann funktioniert, wenn sie für alle zugänglich und attraktiv ist. Dieser Kerngedanken leitet uns bei DeWarmte. Deshalb entwickeln und installieren wir unsere eigenen Wärmepumpen. So machen wir nachhaltiges Heizen intelligenter, bezahlbarer und für immer mehr Haushalte zugänglich.

Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen und bauen aktuell unser Geschäft in NRW aus mit einem neuen Standort in Düsseldorf. Wir leben kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Kommunikation und einen starken Teamgeist. Dir wird Vertrauen und Verantwortung entgegengebracht – und gleichzeitig die Unterstützung, die du benötigst, um erfolgreich zu sein.

 

Deine Aufgaben

Wir wachsen rasant und immer mehr Menschen finden den Weg zu uns. Deshalb suchen wir eine/n Mitarbeiter/in für die Leadqualifizierung, der/ die dafür sorgt, dass jeder interessierte und bestehende Kunde schnell und kompetent betreut wird.

 

Du stehst mit Kunden in Kontakt, hauptsächlich telefonisch und per Video. Du hörst gut zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und hilfst dem Kunden, den logischen nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Manchmal bedeutet das, einen Termin für eine digitale Inspektion zu vereinbaren. Manchmal stellt sich heraus, dass unsere Lösung nicht passt.

Du musst bei deinem Einstieg kein Wärmepumpen-Experte sein. Wichtig ist uns jedoch, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und Energie aus dem intensiven Kundenkontakt schöpfst.

 

Du befasst dich mit:

  • Telefonischer Erstkontakt zu potenziellen Kunden

  • Nachverfolgung und Qualifizierung neuer Leads

  • Bestehende Kunden bei Fragen weiterhelfen und für eine gute Nachbetreuung sorgen

  • Gespräche und Termine ordentlich in unserem CRM-System erfassen

  • Rückrufvereinbarungen und offene Aufgaben eigenständig nachverfolgen

  • Erkennen, wo Kunden auf Schwierigkeiten stoßen, und diese Erkenntnisse mit dem Team teilen

Dein Profil

Für diese Position ist uns deine Arbeitsweise wichtiger als ein bestimmter Abschluss oder eine bestimmte Anzahl an Jahren Berufserfahrung. Du knüpfst leicht Kontakte, hörst gut zu, stellst gezielte Fragen und kannst Informationen auf einfache Weise erklären. Außerdem verfügst du über kommerziellen Ehrgeiz. Es macht dir Spaß, ein Gespräch in die richtige Richtung zu lenken und du traust dich, einen konkreten nächsten Schritt vorzuschlagen. Du bist überzeugend, ohne aufdringlich zu sein. Du findest schnell heraus, was jemand sucht, wie die Situation aussieht und ob es sinnvoll ist, den Prozess fortzusetzen. An einem geschäftigen Tag sprichst du mit verschiedenen Kunden. Das gibt dir eher Energie, als dass es dich abschreckt. Und du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig. Wenn du jemandem versprichst, am Donnerstag zurückzurufen, dann tust du das auch.

Erfahrung im Vertrieb ist schön, aber sicherlich nicht der einzige Weg zu dieser Stelle. Vielleicht hast du im Inbound-Vertrieb, im Telefonverkauf, in einem Callcenter, in der Energiebranche oder in der Telekommunikation gearbeitet. Aber auch Erfahrungen im Gastgewerbe können sehr relevant sein, wenn du dort gelernt hast, schnell Kontakt aufzubauen, gut zuzuhören und kommerziell zu denken.


Dabei helfen dir:

  • Interesse an Technik und Nachhaltigkeit

  • Erfahrung mit Beratungsgesprächen oder Videokonferenzen

  • fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Digitale Skills, z. B. im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot

Wir erwarten nicht, dass du vom ersten Tag an über technisches Wissen zu Wärmepumpen verfügst. Wir bringen dir bei, was du wissen musst. Wir erwarten jedoch, dass du neugierig bist und neue Informationen schnell aufnimmst.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer – GRC & Product Security – Security and IT Team
descriptionHtml:
About Scality

Scality solves organisations' biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable.


The job context

The team

Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers.

You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience.

The mission

You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering.

You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations.


The job description

You will own (Responsible)

  • Security operations coordination: be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team.
  • Vulnerability management: Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation.
  • ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 programs: maintain the framework, policies and procedures in our GRC tool. Run risk analysis and treatment plans, objectives and indicators, and the Statement of Applicability. Prepare internal and external audits and follow up on nonconformities and improvement opportunities.
  • Control management: run the monthly, quarterly and annual controls (account and access reviews across HR system and SSO, application access, offboarding checks), automate them in Jira and keep audit evidence.
  • ISMS processes: run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires).
  • Third-party and application security reviews: assess new SaaS tools, suppliers and internal applications or automations (no-code tools, Slack or AI integrations). Keep the supplier inventory and the service account inventory up to date.
  • AI governance: maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act).
  • Personal data: maintain the personal data inventory and processing records (GDPR, CNIL guidance) together with the data protection contact.
  • Customer trust: answer security questionnaires and RFPs, and prepare evidence packages for customer audits (banking, telecom and public-sector customers).
  • Security awareness: plan and run awareness and phishing campaigns, and track participation and click rates for managers.

    • You will contribute to (Contributor)

  • Product security and certifications: prepare the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical files per product (compliance matrix, risk assessment, SBOM, vulnerability handling, RACI). Also contribute to CISA Secure by Design commitments and UK Cyber Essentials. Bring security input to the product roadmap, the development teams and the product documentation.
  • Data leak prevention: define and tune DLP indicators and alerts (Google Workspace, Salesforce event monitoring) and investigate alerts.
  • Infrastructure security: IaaS/PaaS security, monitoring and SIEM alerting, reporting of security incidents, business continuity and disaster recovery.
  • Automation and tooling: scripts (Python, Bash) and Jira automations that reduce manual work.
  • IT operations: account, application and permission management, level 1 and 2 network and security incidents.
  • Mentoring: onboard and supervise interns or work-study students on security topics.

    • You will be informed of

    Laptop fleet and IT room hardware, SSO integration and SaaS administration, level 3 network management, CI security, and relations with external IT providers. Other team members handle these topics.


    Desired profile

    In general

  • Degree in cybersecurity, information systems or equivalent experience
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in information security, GRC or security operations
  • Based in France

    • Technical skills

  • Practical experience with ISO 27001 (2022): risk analysis, Statement of Applicability, controls, internal or certification audits
  • Knowledge of risk methodologies (ISO 27005, EBIOS RM or similar)
  • Understanding of vulnerability management: CVE, CVSS, SBOM, reading scan and pentest reports
  • Basic knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, SAML/OIDC, MFA, access reviews)
  • Ability to assess the security of a SaaS tool or an application: data flows, permissions, data retention, use of data for AI training
  • Jira (workflows, automation) and spreadsheets for control tracking
  • Python or Bash scripting for automation
  • Clear writing for policies, procedures and answers to customers

    • Bonus skills

  • ISO 42001, EU AI Act or AI risk management (e.g. ISO 23894)
  • EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, CISA Secure by Design, UK Cyber Essentials
  • GDPR and personal data inventories
  • DLP, SIEM, centralized logging and monitoring
  • Linux, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Terraform, Packer, SaltStack
  • Experience in a software vendor and with enterprise customers' security audits

    • Personal skills

  • Organized and rigorous: you run many topics in parallel and follow each one to closure
  • Autonomous and proactive: you follow up with other teams without waiting to be asked
  • Good communicator, able to explain security requirements to non-experts and convince them
  • Curious, eager to learn new norms and regulations as they come out
  • Willing to share knowledge and guide interns

    • Languages

  • Fluent French (the team is based in France)
  • Professional English: daily work with US teams; all policies, documentation and many customer questionnaires are in English

    • Our tools

    GRC platform (OverSecur), Jira and Confluence, OneLogin SSO, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, BambooHR, phishing simulation and awareness platform, internal CVE/SBOM platform, Grafana, vSphere, Terraform, Packer, SaltStack, Python and Bash.

title: Security & Privacy Lead
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As Scarlet's first Security & Privacy Lead, you will own how we protect the information our customers trust us with. They share highly sensitive data with us, and keeping it safe is one of our most important responsibilities. Scarlet is growing fast, and our security and privacy programme has to keep up the pace.

You will own our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and our data privacy programme, and make them scale as we grow. You will work closely with engineering to find and fix risks early, and with teammates across Scarlet so that everyone, from new joiners to contractors, has a secure environment that works for them.

You will also shape how Scarlet adopts AI tools safely, assessing the threat vectors of new tools and helping build an internal ecosystem of AI tools that is secure by design.

As a certification body, we hold ourselves to high standards for information security and data privacy. Your work will help us meet them without slowing anyone down.

Responsibilities

  • Own and improve Scarlet's ISO 27001-certified ISMS.

  • Own and improve Scarlet's GDPR-compliant data privacy programme.

  • Be hands-on with implementing and maintaining controls.

  • Perform information security and data privacy risk assessments for vendors and AI tools.

  • Help build Scarlet's internal ecosystem of AI tools, so that it is secure by design and lets colleagues use AI freely and safely.

  • Lead threat modelling with our engineers, commission external penetration tests and drive their findings to resolution.

  • Represent Scarlet's security and privacy to customers.

  • Proactively monitor our systems and operations to spot real vulnerabilities with practical consequences.

Required qualifications

  • Experience owning an ISMS through ISO 27001 certification or surveillance audits.

  • Experience running a GDPR compliance programme.

  • A track record of being hands-on, implementing security controls yourself, not only advising others on them.

  • Evidence of building a programme that scales. You've turned recurring compliance work, such as policy reviews, evidence collection or security questionnaires, into a repeatable process that handles growing volume without a matching increase in manual work.

  • Experience assessing the information security and data privacy risks of third-party services.

  • Experience working with engineers on threat models and penetration test remediation, with the technical judgement to read an architecture and challenge it.

  • Experience explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues and customers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in a highly regulated environment, such as medical devices or conformity assessment.

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security attestations.

  • Knowledge of AI regulation and standards, such as the EU AI Act or ISO 42001.

  • Experience administering or securing AI platforms or agent tooling in a business setting.

  • Experience automating compliance work.

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

  • Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

  • Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

  • Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

  • Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

  • Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

  • Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.

What Makes This Role Different

This role is focused on converting complex financial and legal documents into structured, reliable data. While experience with chatbots, retrieval systems, and general-purpose AI applications is valuable, the core challenge is building systems that can accurately understand legal documentation and extract the information that powers financial analysis and workflow automation.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Legal Document Intelligence: Deep experience working with complex legal and financial documents, including bond offering memoranda, credit agreements, indentures, court filings, and related transaction documentation.

  • Information Extraction: Expertise in extracting structured data from long, complex documents, including financial terms, covenant provisions, definitions, parties, dates, thresholds, baskets, ratios, and transaction mechanics.

  • Document Understanding & NLP: Strong understanding of document structure, section hierarchy, cross-references, defined terms, tables, exhibits, and other patterns common in legal and financial documentation.
