  • Data Quality & Validation Systems: Ability to design review, verification, and reconciliation workflows that ensure extracted data is accurate, consistent, and auditable.

  • Training Data & Annotation: Experience building labelled datasets, annotation frameworks, synthetic data generation, and evaluation sets for document extraction tasks.

  • Retrieval & Context Engineering: Strong understanding of chunking, document segmentation, retrieval, and context construction for long-document reasoning and extraction workflows.

  • Financial & Legal Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with leveraged finance, debt capital markets, credit agreements, covenant packages, bond documentation, restructuring processes, and related legal concepts.

  • Production ML Engineering: Ability to build and operate extraction pipelines, evaluation systems, model-serving infrastructure, and monitoring for production AI workflows.

  • Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

  • Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

  • You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

  • Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als AI Engineer entwickelst du MAIA weiter und bestimmst von Anfang an mit, wie wir Probleme lösen.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Vom Konzept zum Feature. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement schärfst du grobe Konzepte und verantwortest Features vom Prototyp bis zur Weiterentwicklung anhand von Feedback und Nutzungsdaten.

  • Chat und Agenten. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit MAIA arbeiten: Fragen stellen, Kontext mitgeben und Agenten mehrstufige Aufgaben erledigen lassen – mit nachvollziehbarem Fortschritt und prüfbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Unternehmenswissen erschließen. Du bindest externe Systeme an und machst Wissen aus unterschiedlichen Dateiformaten nutzbar. So findet MAIA die richtigen Stellen, liefert Antworten mit Quellen und hält dabei bestehende Zugriffsrechte ein.

  • Modelle und Qualität. Du integrierst neue Sprachmodelle und vergleichst Qualität, Kosten und Geschwindigkeit. Mit Evals erkennst du Fehler und verbesserst Antworten und Agenten systematisch.

  • Sicher, schnell und stabil. Du baust isolierte Umgebungen für die Ausführung von Code und Tools und verbesserst Antwortzeiten und Datenverarbeitung, damit MAIA auch bei großen Wissensbeständen zuverlässig läuft.

Was wir suchen

  • Solides Software Engineering. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Architektur, API-Design, Datenmodellierung und asynchrone Verarbeitung sind dir vertraut. Schwache Architektur erkennst du auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Zu Hause im LLM-Ökosystem. Du hast echte Anwendungen mit LLMs gebaut, beruflich oder in komplexen eigenen Projekten. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche und Tool Calling kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Frameworks probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Produktionserfahrung mit LLM-Systemen ist ein großes Plus.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Produktdenken. Du denkst an die Person, die mit MAIA unter Zeitdruck ein Angebot fertigstellen oder eine technische Frage klären muss. Du steigst gern früh in die Konzepte des Produktmanagements ein, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein, auch wenn noch nicht alles feststeht.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du schreibst Pläne, die andere prüfen und auf denen Coding Agents aufbauen können, prüfst die Ergebnisse kritisch und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich, auch gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle umfasst keine Personalverantwortung. Ob du als AI Engineer oder Senior AI Engineer einsteigst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview offen mit dir.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 75.000 bis 95.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, hängt von deinem Level ab. Darüber sprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
XALT builds AI solutions that actually work – not just as proof-of-concepts, but in production. As a Senior AI Engineer, you help shape these systems and work right at the intersection of research and real-world application.

What to expect

  • You design and implement AI-powered solutions – from concept to production deployment at our clients.
  • You build scalable LLM, RAG, and agent architectures on modern cloud infrastructure.
  • You collaborate closely with our consulting and engineering teams to translate AI requirements into technical specifications.

  • An open culture with short decision paths, little bureaucracy, and a team that has each other's backs.

title: Senior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Jij zet AI-projecten op vanuit de inhoud en leidt ze tot een tevreden klant.

Een sterk model bouwen is één ding. Een klant laten zien wat AI voor hem kan doen, de juiste oplossing bedenken en die betrouwbaar in productie krijgen: dat is jouw vak.

Als Senior AI Engineer combineer je diepgang in machine learning en MLOps met diepgang in generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bent erbij vanaf het eerste klantgesprek en bent als delivery lead eindverantwoordelijk voor de oplevering.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Nieuwe projecten opzetten: van eerste gesprek tot proposal, met steun van sales. Je inspireert de klant vanuit de inhoud, bedenkt de oplossing en zet een degelijke projectplanning neer.

  • De oplevering leiden: als delivery lead doe je het projectmanagement, geef je dagelijks leiding aan de uitvoering en voer je het stakeholdermanagement.

  • Technische keuzes maken en meebouwen: je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen en bouwt zelf mee. Met een FDE in het team werk je het agentic ontwerp samen uit.

  • Naar productie en draaiend houden: MLOps, monitoring, security en onderhoudbaarheid zijn bij jou geen bijzaak.

  • Het team optillen: je begeleidt collega's en helpt standaarden te ontwikkelen.

Projecten die verder gaan dan het model

We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:

  • Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.

  • Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.

  • Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.

  • Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.

De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Diepgang in ML engineering en MLOps én in GenAI, LLM's en agents, met oplossingen die je zelf in productie hebt gebracht en onderhouden.

  • Je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen, met oog voor evals, monitoring, security en de EU AI Act.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Ervaring met business development én als delivery lead of projectleider.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt.

  • Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.

  • Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur

  • 8% vakantiegeld

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden

  • Goede pensioenregeling

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
  • Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
  • Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
  • Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
  • Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
  • Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
  • Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

    • What you must have
  • Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.
  • A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.
  • Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).
  • Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).
  • Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.
  • Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.
  • Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

    • Get some bonus points
  • PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.
  • Publications at top-tier conferences.
  • Experience in managing a software team.
  • Ability to write production-level code in modern C++
    • RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team. We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (Life Sciences practice)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Bank Infrastructure team at Pleo. This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong.

If you're excited by the challenge of building highly reliable financial systems and want to work in a culture that values transparency, collaboration, and engineering excellence, this role is for you.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer on Bank Infrastructure, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and payment partners across multiple payment schemes (SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT, and others).

  • Own the reliability and correctness of inbound and outbound payment flows, including reconciliation, settlement, and exception handling.

  • Architect systems that are resilient to partner outages, network failures, and edge cases inherent in financial messaging.

  • Lead initiatives to improve system observability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence across payment rails.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities.

  • Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers.

  • Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar).

  • Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling.

  • Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability.

  • Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems.

  • Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana).

  • Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus.

  • Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience owning production payment systems through incidents and operational complexity.

  • High proficiency with AI-enhanced development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Claude) as integrated partners for system design, documentation, and code generation.

  • Willingness to deepen your AI fluency as Pleo scales AI adoption across engineering. We're building a culture where thoughtful AI use for delivery velocity and quality.

  • Proven ability to structure complex engineering problems for AI collaboration, including writing precise specifications, validating generated outputs, and iterative development.

  • A proactive drive to expand your AI fluency as we scale adoption to enhance delivery velocity and maintain high engineering quality across our organisation.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to mentor and upskill teammates.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Bank Infrastructure and work closely with cross-functional teams spanning product, finance operations, compliance, and other engineering squads within Pleo's Payments organisation. Bank Infrastructure is foundational to nearly everything Pleo does, your work will have direct dependencies with and from Card Infrastructure, Credit, and beyond. You'll collaborate with partners across the business to shape how Pleo moves money reliably at scale.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first six months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get deep into Pleo's payment rail architecture, understanding how inbound and outbound bank payment flows are built, monitored, and operated.

  • Take ownership of meaningful initiatives in the bank integration or payment operations domain and drive them from design to production.

  • Build relationships across the engineering organisation, contributing to code reviews and technical discussions beyond your immediate team.

  • Grow your expertise in high-reliability, mission-critical financial infrastructure while contributing to Pleo's broader engineering culture.

We're committed to supporting your growth, whether through expanding your payment systems expertise, stepping into broader architectural influence, or taking on technical leadership responsibilities as Pleo scales.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Coding Interview (Multiple choice)

  3. System Design (whiteboarding session)

  4. Engineering Mananeer Behavioural Interview

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received hundreds of applicants but could only speak with so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Business Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Over Ockto

Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen.

Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing).

Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten.

Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening.

De rol

We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.

In deze rol combineer je strategisch inzicht met een commerciële blik. Je verdiept je in de behoeften, processen en uitdagingen van klanten en onderzoekt hoe Ockto's technologie hierop kan aansluiten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de directe vraag van een klant: je begrijpt de achterliggende behoeften en weet deze te vertalen naar mogelijkheden die zowel voor de klant als voor Ockto waarde toevoegen.

Je bent een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor verschillende stakeholders en weet complexe onderwerpen helder te maken. Je bouwt relaties op, signaleert kansen en draagt bij aan de verdere groei van Ockto. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit onder andere sales, marketing, account management en consulting.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen, klantbehoeften en complexe business vraagstukken om kansen voor Ockto's oplossingen te identificeren.

  • Adviseren van klanten over de mogelijkheden van het platform en de waarde die digitalisering en datagedreven processen kunnen opleveren.

  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met stakeholders en besluitvormers bij potentiële en bestaande klanten.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete business cases en passende oplossingen.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van nieuwe zakelijke kansen en bijdragen aan de commerciële groei van Ockto.

  • Begeleiden van gesprekken en trajecten met klanten, van de eerste behoefteanalyse tot het verder ontwikkelen van een mogelijke samenwerking.

  • Samenwerken met interne teams om klantvraagstukken te vertalen naar haalbare oplossingen en commerciële resultaten.

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en mogelijkheden om Ockto's positie in de markt verder te versterken.

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen om Ockto’s positie in de markt verder te versterken, waarbij je actief bijdraagt aan het benutten van sales mogelijkheden en het uitbouwen van klantrelaties.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren professional die analytisch en strategisch kan denken, maar ook begrijpt hoe je zakelijke kansen realiseert. Je weet de juiste vragen te stellen, kunt snel tot de kern van een vraagstuk komen en voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met uiteenlopende stakeholders.

Je combineert sterke consultancy vaardigheden met commercieel inzicht. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe organisaties werken, begrijpt complexe processen en weet deze te vertalen naar concrete mogelijkheden. Daarbij neem je initiatief, bouw je gemakkelijk relaties op en verlies je de praktische en commerciële doelstellingen niet uit het oog.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring in business consulting, consultative sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Ervaring met het adviseren van zakelijke klanten en het analyseren van complexe business vraagstukken.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op verschillende niveaus.

  • Het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en zakelijke kansen.

  • Een combinatie van analytisch vermogen, strategisch inzicht en commerciële slagkracht.

  • Een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding, met oog voor resultaat en samenwerking.

  • Affiniteit met SaaS, fintech, data oplossingen of digitale dienstverlening is een pré.

Wat biedt Ockto?

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van een Nederlandse SaaS scaleup met een bewezen platform en een groeiend klantenbestand.

  • Een inhoudelijk uitdagende functie waarin strategisch advies, klantrelaties en business development samenkomen.

  • Veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, kansen te signaleren en mee te denken over de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Samenwerking met collega's uit verschillende disciplines, waaronder sales, marketing, account management en consulting.

  • De kans om te werken aan technologie die complexe klantprocessen eenvoudiger, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder maakt.

  • Een salaris tussen de 4250 - 5.250 bruto per maand en arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw ervaring.

Interesse?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met business vraagstukken en klantadvies inzetten om organisaties verder te helpen én bij te dragen aan de groei van Ockto? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Campaign Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW

The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow.

We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering, editorial and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Campaign Operations Manager, your role will be split roughly equally between two areas: campaign delivery, and ad tech.

Campaign delivery (around 50%): You’ll own the delivery and optimisation of client advertising campaigns across Carwow Studio brands and Carwow. You’ll make sure campaigns launch accurately, perform against their KPIs and give clients an excellent experience after the sale.

Ad tech and data (around 50%): You’ll be the team’s go-to expert for our advertising technology and campaign data. You’ll lead the troubleshooting of ad serving, creative rendering, tracking and data discrepancy issues. You’ll also maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows that power our reporting. Working with Product, Engineering and Data teams, you’ll help develop and integrate new tools, features and automated reporting.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while building a reliable, efficient and scalable ad tech and data foundation for Campaign Operations. The role offers a clear path to progress to IC4 Campaign Operations Specialist.

  

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Campaign delivery

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of advertising campaigns across channels, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

  • Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives and KPIs.

  • Monitor performance and lead optimisation with internal teams and clients to meet and exceed campaign KPIs.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients after the sale, covering campaign performance and technical questions.

  • Produce high-quality reports and post-campaign analysis decks, and present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.

  • Identify commercial opportunities, such as upweights, extensions and optimisations, that deliver additional value for clients and Carwow.

Ad tech and data

  • Proactively troubleshoot technical issues across ad serving platforms, creative rendering, campaign tracking and data, minimising delivery and revenue risk.

  • Lead ad tech projects, including implementing new tools, resolving ad server and reporting discrepancies and managing technical integrations.

  • Maintain and improve our ad tech setup and the data flows behind campaign reporting, ensuring accuracy across internal and third-party sources.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Data teams to develop and integrate new ad tech features, tools and automated reporting.

  • Drive the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards.

  • Continuously review processes to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability, and share ad tech and data knowledge across the team.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Proven experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad tech environment.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Google Ad Manager, and experience with a range of creative formats including video, display and HTML5.

  • Confidence troubleshooting technical issues across ad serving, creative rendering, tracking and reporting data.

  • A solid understanding of programmatic advertising, yield management and optimisation techniques.

  • Experience leading or contributing to ad tech or data projects, such as implementing new tools, resolving discrepancies or managing technical integrations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work across multiple data sources and turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, high-quality work in setup, troubleshooting and reporting.

  • Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance and technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A commercially minded, collaborative approach and a genuine interest in improving processes through technology, data, automation and AI.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience in the automotive, publishing or digital media industry.

  • Certifications in Google Ad Manager, Google Ads, programmatic platforms or other ad tech tools.

  • Experience with data and reporting tools such as BigQuery, SQL, Looker or similar.

  • Knowledge of paid social, YouTube, off-site display or demand-generation and lead-generation campaigns.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms.

  • Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects.

WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You’ll need to be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, taking ownership and proactively identifying potential issues before they affect delivery. You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Online interview with the Hiring Manager

  • In-person presentation interview

  • Values Interview

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working (2 days working from home)

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private medical and dental insurance, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

  • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

  • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Commercial Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

As a Senior Commercial Solutions Engineer, you will work with both commercial and some enterprise prospects and customers in Belgium, aligning their goals and requirements with SentinelOne's offerings across prevention, XDR, and threat hunting. You will play an instrumental role in accelerating our sales initiatives, partnering closely with the sales team to design and propose security solutions that address the unique challenges of our customers. If you are a self-starter who thrives in a high-paced environment and is energized by pitching revolutionary technology to executives and security practitioners alike, we'd love to hear from you.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Demonstrable experience speaking to both small and large audiences, with excellent presentation skills and the ability to lead business and technical presentations, demonstrations, and conversations with executives and technical practitioners alike.
  • A team-focused approach, positive attitude, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a larger EMEA team, with a high level of technical curiosity and a passion for emerging technologies across endpoint, mobile, and cloud.
  • Experience in computer forensics, security architecture, penetration testing, red teaming, or incident response is a plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. descriptionHtml:
Avec une stratégie de croissance, le groupe Capco renforce le développement de son pôle FRC (Finance, Risques & Conformité) et tout particulièrement son offre Conformité.

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons pour notre bureau parisien des Senior consultant(e)s, managers ou senior manager afin d’accompagner ses clients sur leurs enjeux de transformation réglementaire et organisationnelle liés à la conformité.

Votre rôle :

Vous participez, pour nos clients du secteur bancaire et financier, à des missions variées qui couvrent plusieurs thématiques :

  • Réaliser des diagnostics de dispositifs LCB-FT (KYC, AML framework, transaction monitoring, filtrage sanctions).
  • Participer à des programmes de remédiation KYC / AML, revues d’efficacité et optimisation des dispositifs existants
  • Contribuer aux programmes AMLR : analyse d’impact réglementaire, déclinaison opérationnelle, gouvernance et trajectoires de mise en conformité
  • Participer à la mise en conformité réglementaire : exigences ACPR, FATF, réglementations locales et européennes (AMLR, eIDAS, DORA, …)
  • Participer à des missions impliquant des outils de sécurité financière (transaction monitoring, sanctions, KYC / CDD), avec une connaissance générale du fonctionnement de solutions du marché (ex. Actimize, NetReveal, Fenergo ou équivalents)
  • Contribuer à la définition ou l’évolution des Target Operating Models conformité (processus, gouvernance, outils, data)
  • Rédiger des politiques, procédures, méthodologies et supports de formation
  • Conduire des évaluations de risques, cartographies, analyses de contrôles et plans de mitigation.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des frameworks de gestion des risques : gouvernance, KPI/KRI, reporting.
  • Participer à la conception ou à l’évolution de dispositifs de contrôle interne.
  • Garantir la qualité et la robustesse des livrables produits
  • Préparer et animer des ateliers, comités et restitutions.

Au sein de Capco :

Le profil recherché :

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme de formation supérieure type école de commerce ou école d’ingénieur, vous justifiez d’une expérience significative en cabinet de conseil et/ou au sein d’institutions financières, sur des sujets de conformité, sécurité financière ou transformation réglementaire
  • Vous disposez d’une excellente compréhension des thématiques LCB-FT, des standards internationaux et des enjeux relatifs à la conformité et sécurité financière (AML, KYC, Sanctions, etc.)
  • Vous disposez d’une solide compréhension des cadres réglementaires applicables à la sécurité financière et à la conformité, notamment :
    • LCB-FT / KYC
    • Pack AML européen (AMLR, AMLD6, AMLA)
    • Interactions avec les superviseurs (ACPR, ECB, autorités locales)
    • Cadres réglementaires : AMLR / AMLD6 / AMLA, recommandations FATF, attentes ACPR / ECB, dispositifs KYC / CDD / EDD, sanctions internationales, MiFID II
  • Vous disposez d’une expérience ou d’une appétence forte pour les outils de sécurité financière (Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, KYC), notamment des solutions du marché telles que Fircosoft, Actimize, NetReveal, Fenergo ou équivalents

De plus, vous avez :

  • Une bonne connaissance des problématiques traditionnelles de la conformité et du risque, mais aussi sur la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règlementations ou de transformations digitales appliquées à la conformité.

Vous faites preuve de leadership, d’un excellent niveau de communication, d’une aisance rédactionnelle, d’un sens aigu de la coordination et d’une capacité à mettre en oeuvre une méthodologie pragmatique et efficace. Vous avez un esprit de synthèse et le sens du détail.

title: Senior Controller (m/w/d) in Berlin – Finance & Controlling bei momox SE
descriptionHtml:
Das Controlling bei momox ist ein Team von vier Personen für ein Unternehmen mit 400 Mio. € Umsatz. Das funktioniert nur, weil bei uns niemand Zahlen verwaltet, sondern jeder sein Thema von der Query bis zur Empfehlung ans Senior Management verantwortet und weil wir konsequent automatisieren, was sich automatisieren lässt. KI ist dabei kein Pilotprojekt, sondern täglicher Bestandteil der Arbeit. Wir suchen jemanden mit dem fachlichen Standing, eigene Themen gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Fachbereichen zu vertreten und mit dem Anspruch, Controlling technisch weiterzudenken.

Das wirst du meistern

  • Management Reporting & Steuerung: Du verantwortest das monatliche Reporting fürs Senior Management inkl. Abweichungsanalysen über Geschäftsbereiche, Vertriebskanäle und Ankaufsländer, und du kommentierst so, dass eine Entscheidung daraus folgt
  • Planung & Forecasting: Du treibst Budget und Quartals-Forecasts, moderierst die Planungsrunden mit Geschäftsführung und Bereichsleitungen und verantwortest das Planungsmodell
  • Deckungsbeitragssteuerung: Du entwickelst unsere Deckungsbeitragsrechnung fachlich weiter und stellst den relevanten Fachbereichen die Kostenbasis für kostendeckende Entscheidungen im An- und Verkauf bereit
  • Business Partnering: Ad-hoc-Analysen, Sonderauswertungen, Profitabilitätshebel - du findest sie selbst, bewertest sie und bringst sie in den Fachbereichen zum Fliegen
  • Daten, Automatisierung & KI: Du ziehst dir deine Daten selbst per SQL aus BigQuery, baust Reports in Looker und automatisierst wiederkehrende Auswertungen, statt sie jeden Monat neu zu klicken. KI-Tools nutzt du dabei für echte Controlling-Arbeit: Datenaufbereitung, Analyse, Code, Prüfroutinen, und entwickelst unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mit weiter

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Controlling eines datengetriebenen Unternehmens (E-Commerce, Handel, Logistik o. ä.)
  • SQL auf Analystenniveau - du wartest nicht auf BI, du schreibst die Query
  • Souverän in Excel/Power Query und in der Modellierung komplexer Planungsrechnungen
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von GuV, Deckungsbeitragsrechnung und Monatsabschluss
  • Praxis im Einsatz von KI-Tools in der eigenen Arbeit - du kannst konkret beschreiben, welchen Prozess du damit verkürzt oder abgeschafft hast
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zahlen verständlich und auf den Punkt zu vermitteln
  • Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten nach einem hybriden Modell mit 20 Office-Tagen pro Quartal, die den persönlichen Austausch im Team fördern und gleichzeitig eine moderne, flexible Arbeitsweise ermöglichen. An den übrigen Tagen kannst du von zuhause aus arbeiten - zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 6 Wochen pro Jahr aus Ländern innerhalb der EU zu arbeiten. Außerdem profitierst du von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deine individuellen Bedürfnisse anpassen.
  • Individuelle Arbeitsumgebung: Gestalte deinen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz ganz nach deinen Wünschen – mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen und dem Laptop deiner Wahl (MacBook oder ThinkPad). Wenn es im Büro mal etwas lauter wird, sorgen deine Bose Noise-Cancelling-Kopfhörer für ungestörtes Arbeiten. Bei Bedarf stellen wir dir auch einen ergonomischen Stuhl oder zusätzliche Monitore für dein Homeoffice zur Verfügung.
  • Offenes Arbeitsumfeld: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam in einem hellen, offenen Großraumbüro, in dem die wenigen vorhandenen Türen immer offen stehen. Unsere Teams sind motiviert und aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen. Bringe deine Kreativität ein und setze sie um! Wenn du einen Moment der Ruhe brauchst, kannst du dich in eine gemütliche Ecke der medimops-Bibliothek im Pausenraum zurückziehen oder dich bei einer Runde Kicker, Tischtennis oder an der PlayStation austoben.
  • Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Unter der Woche hast du die Möglichkeit, an verschiedenen Sportangeboten teilzunehmen. Ob Online-Training, Massagen oder Stretching am Arbeitsplatz – es ist für jeden etwas dabei. Außerdem kannst du zu einem vergünstigten Mitgliedspreis ein Abo bei Urban Sports Club oder Wellhub abschließen.
  • Reduziertes Ticket für den Nahverkehr: Spare bares Geld mit dem Deutschland- oder Jobticket der Berliner S-Bahn.
  • Firmenfeiern: Der Spaß an unserer Arbeit und das gemeinsame Feiern unserer Erfolge sind fest in unseren Werten verankert. Deshalb treffen wir uns regelmäßig zu verschiedenen Events, um uns auszutauschen, besser kennenzulernen und unseren Teamgeist weiter zu stärken.
  • 1/2 Tag Urlaub am Geburtstag: An deinem Geburtstag bekommst du einen halben Tag Urlaub. Komm später, geh früher oder nimm einfach noch einen halben Tag Urlaub dazu, um deinen ganzen Geburtstag frei zu haben – vorausgesetzt, dein Geburtstag fällt auf einen regulären Arbeitstag. Außerdem bekommst du am 24.12. und 31.12. je einen halben Tag frei.
  • Unternehmensrabatte: Als momoxian kannst du dich jeden Monat auf einen Gutschein für unseren momox fashion Onlineshop, sowie medimops freuen. Darüber hinaus profitierst du natürlich von zahlreichen Unternehmensrabatten unserer Partner.
  • Weiterbildung: momox ist nur so gut wie du. Deshalb findest du bei uns Raum und Budget für deine individuelle professionelle Entwicklung mit Sprachkursen, internen Schulungen, Konferenzen, (Online-) Kursen und mehr.
  • Bürohunde: Unsere Bürohunde tragen zu einer entspannten Arbeitsatmosphäre bei und freuen sich immer über eine extra Portion Streicheleinheiten.

Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything.

The Role

As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.

Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You'll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You'll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You'll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally.

What you'll be doing

  • Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally
  • Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA
  • Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments
  • Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking
  • Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions
  • Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency
  • Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading
  • Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary
  • Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns
  • Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before
  • Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs
  • Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)
  • Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience
  • A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience
  • Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload
  • Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy
  • Highly computer literate with:
    • HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)
    • Liquid logic
  • Technical knowledge in CRM automation development
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups
  • Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)
  • CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information..

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
