title: Senior CRM Lifecycle + Journeys Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

The Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.

Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.

You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.
  • Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.
  • Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.
  • Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.
  • Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.
  • Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.
  • Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).
  • Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.
  • Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.
  • Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.
  • SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.
  • A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).
  • Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.
  • Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).
  • Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.

Preferred: 

  • Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Customer Care Manager
descriptionHtml:
Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)

L'équipe


Vous rejoignez l'équipe Customer Services composée de deux teams managées par Thibaut : Support Customer Care et Support L2. L'équipe Customer Care est composée actuellement de 4 personnes.

Le rôle


En tant que Senior Customer Care Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la satisfaction et la fidélisation de nos clients. Avec un portefeuille composée des grandes comptes, vous serez chargé de fournir un support de haute qualité en répondant aux demandes clients, tout en prenant en charge la gestion opérationnelle pour nos clients.

Vous interviendrez également sur des projets transversaux stratégiques, en lien avec les autres équipes métiers, pour contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus et services.

Vos missions principales


Gestion des demandes clients

  • Prendre en charge les tickets entrants en assurant des réponses précises, rapides et de haute qualité.

  • Répondre aux appels des clients sur une plage horaire définie, en assurant un traitement courtois, efficace et orienté solution.

  • Escalader les demandes complexes aux équipes métiers concernées (Payments, Compliance, Produit, Support L2).

  • Analyser les problématiques récurrentes pour identifier les axes d’amélioration et partager vos insights avec les équipes internes.

Gestion des clients prioritaires

  • Être le point de contact opérationnel pour certains de nos top clients, en coordonnant les réponses à leurs demandes et en assurant un traitement prioritaire.

  • Organiser et animer des revues opérationnelles à la demande des clients afin d’assurer un suivi rigoureux de leurs besoins et de leurs attentes.

Projets transversaux et expertise

  • Contribuer à des projets internes stratégiques, tels que la mise à jour de la documentation ou l’optimisation des processus.

  • Devenir référent(e) sur certains outils ou sujets spécifiques (Salesforce, Aircall/Ringover).

  • Accompagner et coacher les membres juniors de l’équipe pour partager vos connaissances et renforcer l’expertise globale de l’équipe.


Expérience et savoir-faire

  • Vous avez au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Customer Care / Support / Success

  • Vous avez une première expérience confirmée en fintech (paiements).

  • Vous avez développé(e) à travers vos expériences un relationnel fort qui vous permet de gérer des comptes complexes avec des stakeholders stratégiques.

Compétences techniques et relationnelles

  • Maîtrise de Salesforce, et d’un outil de téléphonie tel qu’Aircall ou Ringover (indispensable).

  • Une appétence pour les outils techniques et une capacité à analyser des données ou retours clients pour identifier des solutions.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec une approche orientée client.

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais et du français est indispensable. L’espagnol sera un gros plus.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un environnement dynamique et stimulant où vos idées comptent.

  • La possibilité de travailler sur des projets d’envergure en collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

  • Un équilibre vie pro/vie perso avec un poste basé à Paris avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.

Autres avantages

Processus de recrutement

1. Introduction au processus de recrutement avec Sabina, Talent Acquisition Manager
2. Entretien technique avec Thibaut, manager de l'équipe
3. Test de motivation et personnalité (Assessfirst)

3. Echange avec un membre de notre équipe pour mieux comprendre le rôle, l’équipe et notre culture.

4. Entretien avec notre VP Customer Success

Lemonway s'engage à promouvoir la diversité, notamment en favorisant le mixité Femme/Homme et l'emploi de personne en situation de handicap.

title: Senior Customer Service Advisor
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Operations in banking like in every other firm is established to carry out all the day-to-day transactions of the business. The Operations function within Allica has wide-ranging responsibilities supporting the customers of all product lines (Commercial Mortgages, Asset Finance, Deposits and Payment Account with aligned card activity), alongside our own internal stakeholders. We are particularly focused on the following, ensuring that the bank adheres to all relevant Regulatory requirements and our own internal policies and procedures at all times:

  • Slick digital account opening, and in life servicing.

  • Customer contact via telephony, email and in-app communications.

  • Payment and reconciliation activity.

  • Treasury operations.

  • Customer due diligence through Know Your Customer, Know Your Business.

  • Lending pipeline management.

  • Quality assurance and control.

  • Issue resolution.

  • Effective record keeping and data management.

  • Support of all change initiatives.

Role Description

The Customer Service Advisor will be responsible for 1st line customer service support for the Bank’s Retail and SME customers via Chat (Online) and Telephony, together with Back Office activities to support the smooth running of the function.

They will be the focal point for customers – delivering exceptional service whilst living our values and speaking a language our customers will understand and understanding the business and banking challenges our customers face.

Principal Accountabilities

• To field inbound communications from customers – either over voice, chat or social media – to action their requests, resolve their issues and manage complaints through to resolution.

• You’ll be responsible for case management, and this may include outbound customer communications, payments and letter writing.

• Some of the key exceptions you’ll be dealing with will include KYC, complaints, vulnerable customers, deceased/power of attorney cases and SME customers who might have complex needs.

• To proactively identify areas for process improvement and to seek new and innovative ways to better serve the customer.

• To live and breathe the Bank’s values, representing the Bank to customers and speaking to customers in a way that resonates.

• To support other teams as appropriate, where customer communication or engagement is required.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Strong customer service experience, having worked in customer facing and or telephone service roles.

  • Experience using core banking systems and familiar with the use and application of social media as a form of interaction.

  • Experience in dealing with complex complaints and in taking ownership of customer concerns through to resolution.

  • Experience of core processes (e.g. account opening, servicing and closing, payments processing, complaint handling, KYC case referrals, general enquiry management)

  • Experience in working with workflow / task management tools

  • Knowledge of financial services rules and guidelines

  • Excellent oral and written skills as they will be constantly communicating with customers

  • Quickly react and adapt to stressful and difficult situations

  • Enthusiastic and articulate, whilst being motivated by a need to help people

  • A problem solver and can create positive customer outcomes in diverse situations

  • Conform to our ethical standards and conduct

  • Perform administrative tasks related to the customer interaction

  • Deliver outstanding customer service as measured through customer satisfaction KPIs

  • Manage and monitor service providers for customer quality

  • Drive customer service innovation and continuous improvement of process to deliver better customer outcomes

  • Act as an ambassador/advocate for Customer within the Bank

  • Adhere to quality control requirements and ensure compliance with policy

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

Compensation: £30K – £33K • Offers Bonus

title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.

Role Purpose

This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers, designing and implementing solutions that ensure customers integrate deeply with the platform and realise measurable operational outcomes, while bridging the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) teams and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE). They own end-to-end delivery of integration offerings within defined scope, timeline, and budget, escalating only where customer requirements exceed standard package boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

Drive customer success and stickiness

  • Own technical solution design for select customers: from scoping integrations and data workflows through to working implementations that enable full platform value.

  • Deliver the standard Integration/Automation packages end-to-end: scope confirmation, project delivery, build, testing, and handoff within the defined timeline and effort budget.

  • Advise customers and partners on integration architecture: how to connect Mitti to their existing systems effectively and sustainably.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to build implementation plans that accelerate time-to-value for managed accounts.

  • Work alongside Account Executives (AEs) during pre-sales to communicate technical platform capabilities (APIs, security architecture, and cloud integrations) and resolve technical blockers in the sales cycle.

  • Act as a technical bridge between GTM and PDE, capturing and routing customer integration feedback that shapes the product roadmap.

  • Partner with the API and Integrations Engineering team to resolve complex customer requirements and advocate for platform improvements that benefit the broader customer base.

Improve how we deliver

  • Identify recurring technical patterns across customer integrations, propose and participate in standardisation efforts: new packaged offerings, reusable automation, or templated solutions that reduce delivery effort across the customer base, not just for one account.

  • Build and maintain technical automations (scripts, workflows, tooling) that reduce manual effort in the standard delivery motion, contributing them back to the shared Customer Solution & Implementation toolkit rather than keeping them account-specific.

  • Flag when the same "out of scope" request appears repeatedly across customers, as a signal the package boundary itself needs to move, not just that this customer needs an exception.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Proven ability to design and implement data solutions: writing SQL queries, modelling relational databases, and translating raw data into business-relevant insights.

  • Comfortable building across scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang) to automate workflows or extend platform capabilities for specific customer use cases.

  • Able to navigate a wide variety of enterprise system architectures, data models, and integration patterns.

  • Confident reading API documentation and building or troubleshooting API integrations in enterprise environments.

  • Background spanning software development and data analytics; comfortable moving between building solutions and communicating data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Behavioural Skills

  • Translates fluently between technical and non-technical audiences: equally credible in an engineering deep-dive and a customer-facing session with business stakeholders.

  • Stays organised across a high-volume, concurrent workload; switches context quickly without losing quality or missing detail.

  • Customer-first problem solver: listens to understand the real need before proposing a solution, and brings options rather than just problems.

  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; exercises sound judgment on edge cases while operating within a defined delivery methodology.

  • Team-first mindset: invests in the success of CSMs, AEs, and engineering partners, not just their own outcomes.

  • Distinguishes clearly between solving a customer's immediate problem and identifying a systemic delivery improvement worth productising, and routes each appropriately.

AI Skills

  • Uses AI tools to accelerate integration work, drafting technical specs and documentation, analysing customer data to surface insights, and building automations faster.

  • Applies AI coding assistants fluently in day-to-day work; evaluates AI-generated code for quality, correctness, and security before deploying.

  • Proficient with AI tools: independently identifies where AI adds leverage in their workflows and adopts new capabilities without direction.

Benefits

At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • Remote flexible working arrangements

  • Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy

  • Quarterly celebrations and team events

  • Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices.

We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. descriptionHtml:
About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.
About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill.

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.


    • Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

  • Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

  • Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

  • Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

  • Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

  • Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

  • Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

  • Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

  • You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

  • A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves

  • Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

  • Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

  • Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

  • LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

  • A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

Intelligence & Research Operations:

Platform & Application Knowledge:

title: Senior Designer
descriptionHtml:
When you join Exclaimer you will join a global award-winning SaaS provider with an exceptional revenue rate, ambitious growth plans, and an inclusive and outcomes-driven culture.

Exclaimer is a high-growth SaaS company with 300+ colleagues across the UK, US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. We promote a people-first culture built on fairness, inclusion, psychological safety, and continuous learning. As we evolve into a multi-channel platform for branded business communications, we offer employees the opportunity to shape the future of global communication—while growing their careers in a culture where curiosity, creativity, and accountability thrive.  

We’re officially Great Place To Work Certified™

Exclaimer has been recognised by Great Place To Work® for our culture of collaboration, trust, and growth. This certification reflects our commitment to creating an environment where every voice matters and people genuinely enjoy coming to work.  See our accreditations to learn more: Great Place to Work® UK | Great Place To Work® USA

About the opportunity 👇

About the Role 

You will be the in-house design lead for Exclaimer's marketing team, setting the standard for how our brand looks and feels wherever customers and prospects meet it. This is a hands-on role covering campaign creative, paid ads, web and landing page design, events, and motion, working closely with the brand, content, demand generation, and product marketing teams. 

You'll also own quality. Our creative now comes from several places: in-house templates, AI-assisted production, freelancers, and agencies. You'll decide what you design yourself, what can be built from templates or with AI tools, and what goes to an agency, then review the output so everything we publish is consistent and on-brand. 

Speed matters too. Our core web pages need redesigning for answer engine optimization (AEO), and our partner and account-based marketing (ABM) programs are growing. You will help us move faster by building reusable, easy-to-use design systems and by using AI design tools with a designer's eye for quality. 

Key Responsibilities 

Brand Consistency & Quality Control 

  • Own the Exclaimer visual identity, keeping the brand system, templates, and guidelines current and easy to use 
  • Review creative from across the team, freelancers, agencies, and AI tools, and give clear, constructive feedback so everything we publish meets brand standards 
  • Together with the Brand team, decide which requests you design yourself and which are delegated to agencies or produced from templates or with AI, based on audience, visibility, and shelf life 
  • Build reusable, well-documented templates in Figma and/or Canva that colleagues can edit by hand or use with AI tools such as Claude 
  • Brief, direct, and review work from external design partners, and make handovers simple 

Campaign & Paid Creative 

  • Design full campaign asset sets so every touchpoint is consistent, including social ads, web banners, display ads, email and email signature banners, landing page graphics, and infographics 
  • Create conversion-focused ads for LinkedIn and other paid channels, working to each platform's specs and producing variations for testing 
  • Turn product imagery and UI into polished digital assets for paid, web, and sales enablement 
  • Tailor assets for partner and ABM programs, understanding the nuances between audiences 
  • Work with demand generation to use performance data to improve ad creative 

Web & Landing Pages 

  • Design page layouts, outlines, and imagery for landing pages and core website pages, applying UX best practice 
  • Work with the web, content, and SEO teams to speed up the redesign of core pages for AEO 
  • Hand off Figma designs clearly to developers and web agencies 

Events & Creative Concepts 

  • Bring creative ideas to events, activations, and content assets, from concept through to production files 
  • Design event materials across formats, from large-format banners and lightbox graphics to digital signage loops and giveaways 
  • Prepare print-ready artwork and work with print suppliers 

AI-Enabled Design 

  • Use AI design tools (for example Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, and Claude) to speed up production 
  • Test new tools and workflows, and document guidelines so the wider team can use them well 
  • Review every AI output for accuracy, brand voice, and quality before it ships 

Delivery & Collaboration 

  • Manage several campaigns and requests at once, prioritize clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of timelines 
  • Work with brand, content, demand generation, product marketing, web, and channel teams to understand what each asset needs to achieve 

Requirements 

  • Five or more years of experience in brand, marketing, or graphic design, ideally in a B2B, SaaS, or tech environment 
  • A portfolio showing consistent brand execution across web, ads, social, and sales content 
  • Expert Figma skills, including components, variants, Auto Layout, and variables. Experience limited to Canva is not enough for this role 
  • Experience maintaining a brand system, templates, and guidelines for others to use 
  • Proven experience designing conversion-focused ads, with knowledge of specs and best practice across LinkedIn, Meta, and display 
  • UX knowledge for landing page and website layouts 
  • Confident, active use of AI design tools (for example Midjourney, Firefly, Runway, and Claude), and a view on what the latest and best options are 
  • Ability to use AI critically, knowing when and how to apply it while maintaining brand quality and accuracy 
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines 
  • An excellent eye for detail and the ability to give clear, constructive feedback to non-designers 

Nice to have: 

  • Motion design and animation skills in tools such as After Effects or Jitter 
  • Short-form video editing in tools such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Descript 
  • Experience designing for events, print, and experiential activations 
  • Ability to read campaign data and apply it to creative decisions 
  • Experience building or editing pages in Webflow, HubSpot, or WordPress 
  • Experience designing for technical audiences such as IT professionals 

At Exclaimer, we’re proud to offer a benefits package that reflects our commitment to supporting you professionally, personally, and wherever life takes you. 

Alongside competitive pay, you’ll have access to generous paid time off, flexible working options including our XFlex programme and a “work from anywhere” allowance - plus enhanced leave for all new parents, regardless of gender, family structure, or path to parenthood. Our wellbeing offering includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, fully funded insurance and income protection, access to 24/7 virtual care, and mental health, legal and financial support through employee assistance programmes. We help you plan for the future with contributory retirement plans and savings support, and back your day-to-day wellbeing with perks like subscriptions to Calm and Blinkist, fitness and lifestyle credits, global travel assistance and a wide range of discounts. Wherever you're based, you'll find that Exclaimer’s benefits are designed to help you thrive: at work and beyond.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities. title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer – AI Infrastructure (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als unsere erste dedizierte DevOps-Person verantwortest du Infrastruktur und Betrieb von MAIA und entwickelst unsere bestehende Plattform für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt weiter. Die Rolle lebt von enger Abstimmung mit dem Engineering-Team.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Plattform und Deployments. Der Großteil unserer Infrastruktur läuft bei Hetzner, auf dedizierten Servern und Cloud-VMs. Du betreibst diese selbst administrierten Linux-Systeme und bindest ergänzend Dienste von AWS, Azure und GCP an, vor allem für KI-Services. Mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und erprobten Rollbacks machst du Änderungen sicher und reproduzierbar.

  • PostgreSQL im Betrieb. Du verantwortest Performance, Connection Pooling und Kapazitäten und stellst mit getesteten Backups und Restores sicher, dass wir Daten zuverlässig wiederherstellen können.

  • Observability. Du entwickelst unseren selbst betriebenen Observability-Stack weiter, verbindest Metriken, Logs und Traces und etablierst Alerting, das zu konkreten Handlungen führt.

  • Sicherheit und Compliance. Du setzt Least Privilege, Secrets Management, Vulnerability Scanning und Patch Management konsequent um. Für unser laufendes ISO-27001-Vorhaben automatisierst du prüfbare Nachweise.

Was wir suchen

  • Selbst betriebene Systeme. Du hast produktive SaaS-Systeme auf selbst administrierten Linux-Servern betrieben. Erfahrung ausschließlich mit vollständig gemanagten Cloud-Diensten reicht für diese Rolle nicht aus. Erfahrung mit Hetzner ist ein Plus.

  • Container und Automatisierung. Docker und Docker Compose setzt du sicher in Produktion ein, ebenso Reverse Proxies oder API Gateways wie Traefik oder Kong. Infrastruktur verwaltest du mit Terraform, NixOS oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen, CI/CD baust du mit GitHub Actions oder ähnlichen Systemen.

  • PostgreSQL in Produktion. Backups und Restores hast du selbst eingerichtet und getestet. Performance-Analyse und Connection Pooling sind dir vertraut.

  • Observability und Sicherheit. Du hast einen Observability-Stack selbst betrieben, etwa mit Grafana, Loki und Prometheus. Sicherheit setzt du im Alltag um, von Berechtigungen und Secrets bis zu Sicherheitsupdates.

  • Verständnis für KI-Systeme. Du kennst die Grundlagen von RAG-Systemen und ihre typischen Fehlerquellen im Betrieb. Bei LLM-Serving kannst du Zielkonflikte zwischen Latenz, Durchsatz, Kosten und Betriebsaufwand einordnen. Neue Modelle und Anbieter verfolgst du aus eigenem Interesse.

  • Eigenständig und sorgfältig. Du treibst Themen selbst voran, untersuchst unbekannte Systeme, bis du sie verstehst, und priorisierst nach Risiko und Wirkung. Komplexität hältst du beherrschbar, und Verbesserungen bringst du bis in den laufenden Betrieb.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag, auch bei Infrastruktur. Du prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch, besonders bevor etwas in Produktion geht.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Auch bei Störungen bleibst du ruhig und klar. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du verständlich, auch Menschen ohne technischen Hintergrund. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle ist eine Senior-Rolle ohne Personalverantwortung.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 80.000 bis 90.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, IaaS
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the IaaS group builds the layer they stand on: Kubernetes, networking, and storage, running on our own bare metal.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. The org hires about ten engineers a month, and this group carries one of the largest shares.

The Role

You will lead three teams: Managed Kubernetes, Network, and Storage. Managed K8s and Network run today, each with its own lead. Storage is yours to build: charter, first lead, first hires, first systems in production. The group is about a dozen engineers today and roughly doubles this year.

Your reports are team leads. The work is direction, staffing, and the seams between the teams: where Kubernetes meets the network, where both meet storage, and where the group meets the metal underneath. You stay technical enough to challenge architecture calls and to know when to trust the people making them.

This is a second-line seat for an engineer who moved into management to build world-class organisations. Opportunities like this don’t come up often.

What You Will Do

  • Own delivery and health across three teams' roadmaps. Projects ship with the reliability that finance, healthcare, and public-sector workloads demand.

  • Manage and grow team leads. Set the standard, hold it, and grow the ones who want your seat one day.

  • Build the Storage team from zero: define its charter (object and block storage, capacity planning, tiering, backup), hire its lead and engineers, and put the first systems into production.

  • Own the seams: architecture that crosses Kubernetes, network, and storage, and the boundary with the fleet and hardware-design groups below you.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities and make the tradeoffs between what customers need now and what the platform has to become.

  • Hire. Your group carries a big block of the org's openings; you build the machine that fills it and onboards people fast.

  • Raise the engineering bar through mentoring, feedback, and the standard your leads copy.

What We're Looking For

  • You have led multiple engineering teams in production infrastructure as a second-line manager. Managing managers, running several teams at once, is the experience we need.

  • Your ground is orchestration: you have run Kubernetes or compute orchestration at real scale, shipped systems in Go, and worked on Linux itself, below the managed-service layer.

  • You know network and storage well enough to challenge specialists and tell a sound design from a lucky one.

  • You are comfortable next to hardware. This group runs on Mistral's own metal, and you will work with the fleet and hardware teams every week.

  • You have built a team from nothing: written the charter, made the first hires, shipped the first system.

  • You have grown leaders, not only engineers. People you managed now run teams of their own.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: Senior Finance Analyst
descriptionHtml:

Drive the end-to-end process for the 13-week cash flow forecast - from gathering inputs and analysing variances to refining assumptions, ensuring high-confidence projections for senior management.

Drive automation projects — to streamline processes, improve data integrity, and create scalable workflows, while training our shared service centre to take on operational day to day responsibilities.

title: Senior Finance & Strategy Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and want to model the future of a global tech brand—this is the team for you.

We're looking for a Senior Manager to join our Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you'll play an integral part in building our business strategy, ensuring we make the most efficient investment and capital allocation decisions to accelerate our global growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We partner cross-functionally to improve the profitability, scalability, and defensibility of our business model, carrying projects from initial conception through to final execution.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Decision Support: Partner with stakeholders across the business to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and drive strategy in a dynamic environment.

  • Growth vs. Profitability: Own complex models and analyses to help the business strike the optimal balance between aggressive growth and long-term profitability.

  • Custom Financial Modelling: Lead high-impact modelling exercises to support key initiatives, sizing new opportunities and building business cases for innovative products.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key financial and business KPIs to uncover trends, assessing current and future risks while identifying new market opportunities.

  • Process Innovation: Lead special projects to automate and scale our forecasting and reporting tools, ensuring our methodologies evolve alongside the business.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with operators and departmental leaders to develop new policies and ensure day-to-day execution aligns with our financial targets.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Finance Leadership: Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within a high-growth tech environment.

  • Team Development: Proven track record of managing and mentoring teams; you are passionate about building a high-performing "gold standard" finance function.

  • Influencing Power: The ability to earn the trust of senior leaders and influence strategic thinking across a matrixed organisation.

  • Technical Mastery: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with the ability to build robust, complex financial models that distill data into digestible insights.

  • Budget Ownership: Experience owning forecasts and budgets for major functional areas, working directly with operators to hit performance targets.

  • Data Agility: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large datasets and uncover hidden business insights.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Native-level French proficiency is required for this role. Candidates must be able to lead customer workshops, conduct executive presentations, and manage stakeholder interactions in French.

The role is based in Paris.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in one or more industries (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer, Retail, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals) and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities 

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. title: (Senior) Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Empower every employee.

KI hat verändert, wie Büroangestellte arbeiten. Bei den 80 % der weltweiten Belegschaft, die nicht am Schreibtisch sitzen, ist sie bisher kaum angekommen. Flip AI ändert das.

Flip AI ist das #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS), mit dem sich jeder Anwendungsfall für Frontline-Teams aufbauen, automatisieren und orchestrieren lässt, auf einem Fundament aus sicherer Identität, Kommunikation und starker UX. In der Praxis heißt das: eine App, über die Frontline-Mitarbeitende in Handel, Produktion und Logistik auf ihre Systeme zugreifen, ihre Prozesse abwickeln und KI nutzen.

Mehr als 1.000 Marken vertrauen Flip AI, und über zwei Millionen Menschen weltweit nutzen die Plattform, bei Unternehmen wie Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA und Greif. Im August 2026 haben Notion Capital und HV Capital mit einer neuen Runde über 25 Mio. US-Dollar erneut investiert, insgesamt sind es damit mehr als 85 Mio. US-Dollar.

Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Customer Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Produkt und der Umgebung unserer Kund:innen: ihrem Identity-Stack, ihren HR-Systemen, ihrem Security Review, ihrer KI-Roadmap. Du bringst einen Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite.

  • Integrationen, die Flip AI tragfähig machen: Du designst und lieferst Identity und Authentifizierung (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), SCIM-Provisioning, REST-APIs und Anbindungen an HR- und operative Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Beraten und befähigen statt selbst abarbeiten: Du führst die IT auf Kundenseite, ihre Partner und unsere externen Entwicklungspartner zu einer Lösung, die du selbst unterschreiben würdest, und sorgst dafür, dass sie ohne dich betrieben werden kann.

  • Bauen, wo es den Rollout löst: Wo Bauen der schnellste Weg ist, einen Ansatz zu belegen oder ein Rollout wieder in Bewegung zu bringen, baust du die erste Version und übergibst sie danach sauber, mit Dokumentation und Übergabegespräch, damit sie Bestand hat.

  • KI dort, wo sie auf den Kunden trifft: Du gestaltest, wie Agents, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und Agent-to-Agent-Szenarien in echten Enterprise-Umgebungen ankommen, inklusive der Auth- und Datengrenzen, die dabei halten müssen.

  • Technische Autorität im Account: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit Projektleitung, IT, Security, Fachbereichen und Betriebsräten ab, entscheidest die technischen Fragen und gibst die Lücken, die du dabei siehst, an unser Produkt- und Engineering-Team zurück. Rechne mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kund:innen, etwa 10 bis 30 Prozent deiner Zeit.

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves

  • Rund 3 bis 5 Jahre (oder mehr) in der IT- oder Tech-Beratung, im Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering oder in der SaaS-Implementierung, mit echter Enterprise-Erfahrung.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integration und Identity: SSO und Authentifizierung (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID oder vergleichbar), REST-APIs und API-basierte Integrationen, die du in echten Enterprise-IT-Landschaften geliefert hast.

  • Technische Verantwortung am Kunden in Enterprise-Projekten, in denen du die technischen Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit IT, Security und Fachbereichen getroffen und nicht nur koordiniert hast.

  • Echte technische Tiefe, ohne in Vollzeit Produktcode zu schreiben: Du liest Code, prüfst ein Design, debuggst eine Integration und baust einen funktionierenden Prototypen.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher und fließendes Englisch.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit SCIM-Provisioning und Anbindungen an HR- oder Workforce-Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG.

  • Ein fundierter, aktueller Blick darauf, wohin sich agentische KI entwickelt: MCP, A2A, EMA und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter. Wir suchen jemanden, der das Feld eng verfolgt und eine eigene Meinung dazu hat, keine Jahre an Erfahrung, die es noch nicht geben kann.

  • Vorerfahrung als Customer Engineer oder Forward Deployed Engineer in einem Produktunternehmen statt ausschließlich in der klassischen Beratung.

  • Tools zur Workflow-Automatisierung (n8n oder ähnlich), Routine mit Logs, Metriken und Dashboards oder Erfahrung mit Mitbestimmung und Datenschutz im Enterprise-Umfeld.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. title: Senior FP&A Analyst
descriptionHtml:
💰 Up to £95k depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Hybrid, with flexible hours.

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200m+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Close, audit, tax and payments operations are already covered by the finance team. What has not been built yet is planning. This role exists to make planning a discipline the leadership team uses every week: a forecast budget owners trust, and unit economics that change decisions.

🎯 The Role

We're hiring a Senior FP&A Analyst/Senior Commercial Analyst to build and own Fanvue's company model, forecasting and commercial analysis, reporting to our VP Finance.

This is hands-on. You will build the driver-based model the executive team and board run the business on, turn creator, fan and payments data into unit economics people act on, and partner directly with budget owners across the business. It suits someone who has built models from scratch, pulls their own data, and can put a number on every outcome they claim.

This is not a reporting role. Someone strong on reporting but weak on building models is the wrong hire here, however polished.

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Build and own the company model: a driver-based forecast with base, upside and downside cases that leadership and the board use

  • Forecast GMV and net revenue from the real drivers: creators, paying fans, spend per fan, cohorts, seasonality and take rate

  • Run the budget and monthly reforecast, and explain variances in terms budget owners can act on

  • Analyse unit economics, cohorts, pricing and margin, and use that analysis to change pricing and deal decisions

  • Partner with department heads on spend, bringing data and options rather than simply saying no

  • Pull your own data with SQL, reconcile it back to the ledger, and automate reporting so it runs without you

  • Bring AI tools into the planning and reporting workflow

  • Own monthly investor reporting and contribute to board packs and fundraising data rooms

👀 Who You Are

  • You have built a driver-based forecast or company model from scratch, and can walk through every driver in it

  • You have done analysis that changed a pricing, deal or spending decision, and you know the numbers before and after

  • You write SQL and are comfortable in a BI tool. You do not wait for someone else to hand you the data

  • You have run budget reviews with department heads and are trusted by them

  • Experience in a two-sided marketplace, payments, subscription or e-commerce business

  • A scale-up background, ideally having built something from scratch in ambiguity and chosen that stage

Nice to have

  • Experience in the creator economy or a high-risk payments category

  • Exposure to a fundraise or a data room

  • Reporting pipelines automated end to end

  • Background in STEM

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want to build the planning function rather than maintain a model someone else designed

  • You would rather pull the data yourself than wait for it

  • You like being in the room when the decision is made, not reporting on it afterwards

  • You are comfortable telling a department head the number does not support the spend, and then helping them find a way that does

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You see FP&A as reporting, and want a finished model to maintain

  • You need an ERP or established planning tools in place before you can start

  • You prefer to police budgets rather than partner with the people who own them

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Build planning from the ground up at a company growing this fast

  • Direct exposure to leadership, the board and investor reporting

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the work you do now sets the standard for years

  • Unlimited holiday

  • Hybrid working, with flexible hours according to when you work best

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Budget for growth and wellbeing, plus support with upskilling and development costs

  • A culture built on innovation, speed, excellence, ownership and transparency

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

title: Senior Graphic Designer

The brand rests on a fine balance of medical rigor, premium design and a warm tone. Our products are built to last for years, not for a single product cycle.

Your body already knows. Withings helps you hear it.

As Senior Graphic Designer, you will be the graphic backbone of our in-house creative studio. You will create, adapt, challenge and grow the Withings brand image, from product launches to brand guidelines, and imagine the visuals that bring our products to life around the world.

The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027.

We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked.

AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality.
