title: Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

VÆRIDION is a pioneering electric aircraft Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) dedicated to revolutionizing regional air mobility and sustainable aviation. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions.

As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team.

Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define performance, functional, installation and other applicable system requirements, allocate them to components, and plan and support their validation and verification (V&V) in line with standards such as ARP4754.

  • Define HV system functions, architecture, sizing and specifications, and integrate the aircraft HV distribution system to meet safety and performance requirements.

  • Develop interface control documents (ICDs) covering physical and functional interfaces with the aircraft structure and related systems.

  • Lead technical tasks for Microliner development and certification, and create system documentation from requirements definition to demonstration of compliance.

  • Define aircraft-level HV electrical bonding and grounding requirements and their implementation.

  • Coordinate HV system safety analyses and systems engineering activities, address environmental conditions including HIRF and EMI, and define lightning protection requirements for the HV propulsion electrical network based on the defined aircraft lightning zones.

  • Define and specify the aircraft charging interface, and break down its requirements to component level.

  • Specify power quality and electrical insulation requirements and draft the aircraft electrical load analysis, including tasks such as defining and maintaining a Y-capacitance budget for the propulsion electrical network and allocating limits to components.

  • Support integration of the HV system digital mock-up (DMU) into the aircraft 3D model.

  • Identify, assess and manage suppliers, and own work packages for the development, installation and integration of HV components, including fuses, switches, harnesses and grounding systems.

  • Perform or support analyses and simulations to improve HV propulsion battery performance, reliability and integration into the propulsion system.

  • Participate in supplier technical and program reviews (TRM and PRM) and key milestones, including PDR, CDR, First Flight and Type Certification.

  • Define and plan HV equipment qualification campaigns with the Technology Department, suppliers and other stakeholders.

  • Prepare, commission, troubleshoot and execute HV hardware and software tests, from component benches to full-scale prototypes and aircraft ground and flight tests.

  • Follow engineering processes and standards, and contribute to design reviews supporting development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or higher in electrical engineering or a related field.

  • Proven experience of at least 5 years in electrical systems design and integration within an aerospace OEM or similar industry (preferably automotive).

  • Experience with electric aircraft is a plus, including power electronics, energy storage and electric propulsion systems.

  • Working knowledge of systems engineering and safety analyses per aerospace standards such as ARP4754 and ARP4761 or automotive standard such as ISO26262. Proficiency on airborne hardware and software qualification per ED-12/ED-80 (DO-178/DO-254), and practical experience with aircraft certification is a plus.

  • Practical experience with aircraft certification process (preferably EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25).

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J Design Organization, or international equivalent is preferred.

  • Assertive and clear communication skills, results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Ability to interact efficiently with customers, authorities, suppliers, and internal organizational units.

  • Proven ability to prioritize, manage, and execute multiple simultaneous tasks.

  • Skilled in navigating early design uncertainties and driving progress through proactive proposals and collaborative idea sharing.

  • Positive and optimistic attitude, with a collaborative approach in a multicultural team, adhering to company rules and values.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR-afdeling en administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR-processen, toepassing van arbeidsvoorwaarden en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR-medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR-processen en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR administratie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: Senior IA Inference Engineer (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Inference Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in AI & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to power Doctolib's AI-driven healthcare products — from Consultation Assistant to Phone Assistant and Health Companion — by owning the self-hosted LLM serving platform that keeps the most sensitive patient data within infrastructure Doctolib controls. You will build and operate the shared foundations that every AI feature team relies on: deploying, tuning, and scaling open-weight models across our GPU fleet, contributing directly to faster, safer, and more cost-efficient AI for care teams and patients across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build the shared LLM serving foundations with MLOps engineers — define the serving stack, GPU capacity planning, and deployment automation for open-weight models (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen, and their fine-tuned variants) on Ray Serve / Anyscale, while shaping the evolution toward Kubernetes-based orchestration

  • Own the model registry and promotion path — establish clear processes for versioning, validating, and promoting models into production, benchmark performance and output quality under realistic workloads, and maintain the curated model catalog together with the Agents Platform team

  • Optimize inference performance and efficiency — operate and tune serving engines (vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM) to reduce time-to-first-token, inter-token latency, and cost per token through batching, caching, quantization, and parallelism strategies across our GPU fleet (L4 to H200)

  • Own production reliability and disaster recovery — define SLOs, run load tests before launches, implement safe rollouts, rollbacks, and autoscaling, and participate in on-call and incident response

  • Make serving performance and costs measurable — build Datadog dashboards, alerting, and cost reporting to track latency, GPU utilization, and inference spend, and identify opportunities to improve resource efficiency

  • Keep the inference stack secure, compliant, and evolving — work with Security and Privacy on network isolation, data residency, and auditability, while continuously assessing new models, serving engines (such as SGLang), and GPU generations

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of software or computer engineering experience, including hands-on production experience with at least one LLM serving engine (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, or Triton) — ideally having chosen, introduced, tuned, or scaled one in production, not just run it with defaults

  • Are proficient in Python and Terraform, with a solid understanding of transformer inference mechanics: prefill vs. decode, KV cache, batching strategies, and why a model is compute- or memory-bound on a given GPU

  • Have strong experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes or a managed Ray / Anyscale platform, and a performance engineering mindset — you design reproducible benchmarks, read profiler output, and back decisions with numbers

  • Are comfortable owning production reliability: observability, incident response, and on-call are a natural part of the role

  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, high agency, a pragmatic build-vs-buy approach, and are comfortable working in a scope that is still taking shape

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with distributed serving frameworks (KServe, llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo), including disaggregated prefill/decode or KV-cache-aware routing, or with serving Mixture-of-Experts, multimodal models, or many LoRA adapters on shared base models

  • Have GPU kernel experience or deep profiling skills (CUDA, Triton, Nsight), or have contributed to open-source inference projects

  • Have experience in regulated environments (healthcare, finance, public sector) and with frameworks such as GDPR, HDS, ISO 27001, or SOC 2

Our stack

  • Programming languages: Python, plus comfort reading/debugging a systems language (C++, Rust, or Go)

  • Cloud providers: GCP / AWS / Azure

  • Serving orchestration: Ray Serve / Anyscale (GCP), with Kubernetes (GKE) + GPU scheduling as an emerging parallel target

  • LLM serving engines (in production): vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM (also evaluating SGLang and other emerging engines)

  • Models: Self-hosted open-weight LLMs (Gemma, Mistral, Llama, Qwen), fine-tuned in-house

  • Experiment tracking & model registry: MLflow

  • GenAI gateway: LiteLLM

  • LLM evaluation & observability: Braintrust

  • GPUs: NVIDIA L4, A10G, L40S, RTX 6000 Pro, A100 (40GB/80GB), H200

  • Container / Infra as code: Docker, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Data warehouse / storage: GCP BigQuery / GCS / AWS S3

  • And any other tool you deem relevant!

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • HR interview by phone (45 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (1 hour)

  • Technical case study (1 hour)

  • Behavioral interview (1 hour 30 minutes)

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Tech stack: Python, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Ray Serve

  • Full-time

  • Paris, France

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: France. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: (Senior) Implementation Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Dafür bauen wir ein eigenes Consulting-Team auf, und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.


Die Rolle

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach der Unterschrift und bringst sie in den ersten 90 Tagen in die produktive Nutzung. Du leitest den Kick-off, klärst mit dem Kunden, wer ausschreibt und mit welchem Projekt es losgeht, schulst Einkauf, Kalkulation und Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass die ersten Ausschreibungen rausgehen und Angebote zurückkommen. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, merkst du es früh und drehst ihn, notfalls über die Geschäftsführung. Nach 90 Tagen übergibst du ihn mit klarem Stand an seinen Account Manager.

Du begleitest viele Kunden parallel, vom Familienbetrieb bis zum Generalunternehmer mit mehreren Niederlassungen. Als Senior Implementation Consultant übernimmst du die komplexen Einführungen: mehrere Standorte oder Gesellschaften, Freigabeprozesse, Systemlandschaften und viele Beteiligte. Und du entwickelst mit, wie unser Consulting-Team arbeitet.

Du berichtest an die Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Deine Kunden sind nach 90 Tagen produktiv: Sie schreiben über Cosuno aus und erhalten Angebote, nachweisbar im Activation Report.

  • Jeder Kick-off endet mit klaren Zusagen: ausschreibende Nutzer, erstes Projekt, Termine, Mandat der Geschäftsführung.

  • Kunden, die hinter Plan liegen, haben schnell einen Plan, und die meisten holen auf.

  • Deine Kunden bewerten ihr Onboarding gut, und dein Account Manager weiß bei der Übergabe genau, wo der Kunde steht.

  • Als Senior: Deine komplexen Einführungen erreichen ihr Ziel, und das Team arbeitet mit Bausteinen, die du entwickelt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, rufst du an, statt auf die nächste Mail zu warten.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du gern erklärst und es dich reizt, gerade die Skeptiker zu überzeugen.

  • du lieber vom Ziel rückwärts planst, als Schulungen abzuarbeiten.

  • du bei vielen Kunden parallel den Überblick behältst und weißt, wer heute deine Zeit bekommt.

  • du mit Kalkulatoren und Geschäftsführern gleichermaßen auf Augenhöhe sprichst.

  • du verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft und vergeben wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Onboarding als eine Reihe von Produktdemos verstehst.

  • du lieber in langen Projekten mit wenigen Kunden berätst als viele Kunden schnell zum Ergebnis zu bringen.

  • du wartest, bis der Kunde sich meldet.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Mindestens ein Jahr eigene Verantwortung für die Einführung einer Software beim Kunden, etwa als Implementation Consultant, Onboarding Manager oder Customer Success Manager mit Onboarding-Schwerpunkt, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS.

  • Erfahrung mit vielen parallelen Kunden und belegbare Ergebnisse, zum Beispiel Go-live- oder Aktivierungsquoten.

  • Du hältst Schulungen und Workshops souverän, online und vor Ort.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch, Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS und sicherer Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen sind ein Plus.

  • Für Senior Implementation Consultant zusätzlich: Einführungen bei Kunden mit mehreren Standorten, Gesellschaften oder Systemen und viel Kontakt zur Geschäftsführung.

Was wir bieten

  • Aufbau: Du bist von Anfang an Teil eines neuen Teams und gestaltest mit, wie wir Kunden in die Nutzung bringen.

  • Wirkung: Klare Ziele und direkter Einfluss darauf, ob ein Kunde bleibt.

  • Entwicklung: Vom Implementation Consultant zum Senior über immer komplexere Kunden, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s und offener Feedbackkultur.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt.

  • Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Kennenlernen mit unserem Head of Customer Success (45 Minuten)

  2. Gespräch mit der Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams (30 Minuten)

  3. Case Study an einem realistischen Neukunden, dazu ein Gespräch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Team

  4. Referenzgespräch, danach unser Angebot

title: Senior Implementation Consultant (French)
descriptionHtml:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Our Implementations and Onboarding team is responsible for understanding the relationships and desired outcomes established during the sales process, building a launch plan for success, and helping customers get the most out of 1Password's suite of products.

We are customer-obsessed, technically curious, and committed to building deep, trusted partnerships that help organizations succeed securely with 1Password.

As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will lead the technical deployment and customer enablement of 1Password's product suite for our largest and most strategically important enterprise customers. You will own the hands-on configuration and rollout of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, Device Trust and Unified Access while delivering tailored, high-impact training that drives deep adoption and long-term customer value. Partnering with a Project Manager, Technical Account Managers, and Solutions Architects, you will be the trusted authority in each engagement, bringing both advanced product expertise and sharp business acumen to complex, high-visibility deployments. You will approach your work as an AI builder by actively developing AI-powered workflows and automation to scale your impact, accelerate outcomes for customers, and raise the standard for what implementation excellence looks like at 1Password.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

What we're looking for:

  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to engage and develop relationships, sharing information effectively across all professional levels.

  • Excellent communication in Spanish is a plus

  • 6+ years of experience in a technical implementation, solutions engineering, customer onboarding, or related B2B SaaS function, with a demonstrated track record of leading enterprise software deployments for large, complex, or strategically critical organizations

  • Advanced technical expertise and hands-on experience deploying SaaS products in enterprise environments, including deep working knowledge of identity providers (IdPs), SSO, SCIM, Active Directory, MDM, device trust, and Zero Trust security frameworks

  • Expert-level understanding of the business cases for enterprise security, IT operations, and SaaS governance tools and able to fluently navigate both technical and strategic conversations with IT administrators, security teams, and C-suite stakeholders

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, high-visibility enterprise engagements with multiple competing priorities, maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines

  • Proven ability to design and deliver advanced, engaging virtual training and enablement programs for enterprise customers, including technically sophisticated administrators and executive audiences

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leadership and serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders

  • Strong judgment in identifying and resolving technical issues, with the ability to lead de-escalation efforts and drive outcomes autonomously

  • A builder's mindset toward AI. You actively develop with AI tools and automation, creating workflows, solutions, and accelerators that meaningfully improve how you and your team work; you are not a casual user but a practitioner who builds

  • Experience mentoring and coaching peers and junior team members, sharing expertise and elevating the capability of those around you

  • Familiarity with SCIM, AD/LDAP, CLI, SSO, BYOD, MDM, SaaS discovery, and device posture concepts

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 1Password or experience deploying identity and access management, password management, device trust, or SaaS management solutions at enterprise scale

What you can expect:

  • Drive the successful technical implementation and deployment of Enterprise Password Manager, SaaS Manager, and Device Trust (and Unified Access as it becomes available) for large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, owning hands-on configuration, integration, and validation through to a successful launch

  • Partner with the assigned Project Manager to align on timelines, dependencies, and internal coordination. You own the technical delivery and customer enablement while the Project Manager owns project coordination; together you ensure a seamless, high-quality customer experience

  • Collaborate closely with Technical Account Managers and Solutions Architects to assess customer environments, align on architectural decisions, and design implementation approaches that meet both technical requirements and business objectives

  • Build deep knowledge of each customer's environment, security posture, business goals, and user workflows in order to design deployment strategies and training plans that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes

  • Deliver advanced, customized virtual training sessions for enterprise administrators and end users across all deployed 1Password products while adapting instructional approaches to technically diverse audiences and highly complex organizational environments

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for customers and internal stakeholders alike, translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from IT and security teams to executive leadership

  • Manage escalated situations on complex or sensitive implementations, working cross-functionally with internal teams and engaging directly with customers to de-escalate and drive the best possible outcome

  • Exercise independent judgment in identifying and mitigating implementation risks, developing and executing resolution strategies proactively and keeping all relevant stakeholders informed

  • Stay ahead of product updates, new features, and evolving integrations across our products and applying that knowledge immediately in customer engagements and sharing it with the broader team

  • Develop and maintain advanced implementation playbooks, training curricula, and enablement resources (including configuration guides, deployment frameworks, and possibly video content) that elevate the capabilities of the entire Implementations and Onboarding team

  • Mentor Implementation Managers and other junior team members, sharing deep product expertise, enterprise deployment strategies, and insights gained from working with our most demanding customers

  • Influence team operations by leveraging lessons from complex engagements to recommend and drive improvements to team practices, processes, documentation, and the overall customer journey

  • Build with AI not just use it. Actively develop AI-powered workflows, automation, and tools that improve your own delivery, help customers achieve faster time-to-value, and create scalable solutions the broader team can adopt

  • Contribute significantly to the growth strategy of the Implementations function, identifying opportunities to evolve how we deploy and enable customers at scale

  • Occasionally represent 1Password at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £61,000 GBP and £88,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Implementation Engineer – Phone Assistant (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Implementation Engineer als Unterstützung für das Technical Onboarding Team in Berlin. Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unsere komplexesten Implementierungen des KI-basierten Telefonassistenten und stellst sicher, dass Praxen und Krankenhäuser ein effizientes, zuverlässiges und nachhaltiges Onboarding-Erlebnis haben. Als technischer Sparring Partner im Team entwickelst Du Standards, Prozesse und Lösungen, die unser Onboarding skalierbarer machen – und wirkst mit Deinen Verbesserungen weit über den eigenen Bereich hinaus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst technisch anspruchsvolle Installationen und Konfigurationen des KI-gestützten Telefon Assistenten bei Key Accounts – inklusive komplexer Telefonanlagen und Eskalationsfälle, und sorgst so für eine konsistent gute Onboarding-Journey unserer Kund:innen.

  • Du treibst unsere Multi-Onboarding-Strategie voran und verantwortest mittelfristig auch das Onboarding unseres Kalenders und unserer All-in-One Praxissoftware – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Technical Onboarding Teams.

  • Stakeholder Management: Du bist die primäre technische Ansprechperson für Key Accounts, deren IT sowie für Key Account Manager:innen und pflegst aktiv die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern aus Sales, Deployment und Product.

  • Wissenstransfer & Coaching: Du coachst Kolleg:innen, teilst Dein Know-how proaktiv und definierst Best Practices, Playbooks und Trainingsmaterialien – für ein höheres technisches Niveau und mehr Konsistenz im gesamten Team.

  • Projektmanagement: Du initiierst und leitest eigenständig cross-funktionale Projekte zur Prozessverbesserung und treibst den gezielten Einsatz von KI-Tools voran, um repetitive Aufgaben zu automatisieren und Kapazitäten für das Wesentliche freizusetzen: unsere Kund:innen und ihre Patient:innen.

  • Du nutzt operative Daten und Kundenfeedback, um Verbesserungen in Produkt und Prozess voranzutreiben – z. B. in Feedback Loops mit Tech und Product.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Onboarding oder Technical Support mit komplexen Systemen – idealerweise mit Telefonanlagen oder vergleichbarer Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur

  • Erfahrung in der direkten Kundenbetreuung sowie im Stakeholder Management mit externen Ansprechpartner:innen und internen Teams

  • Eigenständige Lernbereitschaft und nachweislicher Impact bei Prozess- und Projektverantwortung

  • Erfahrung im aktiven Einsatz von KI-Tools und in der Förderung ihrer sinnvollen Nutzung im Team

  • Fließendes Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mind. B2)

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

Der Interviewprozess

  • Interview mit dem Talent-Team

  • Interview inkl. Livecase mit den Hiring Manager:innen

  • Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

Job Details

  • Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit

  • Berlin

  • Gehaltspaket: 58.000 - 63.000€ brutto/jährlich (inkl. 8% Bonus)

title: Senior Influence Executive
descriptionHtml:
Senior Influence Executive

Department: Influence 
Location: London
Contact type: 12-Month Fixed Term Contract 
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Business Director 

About the Role

WPP Onefluence is seeking a dynamic and trend-savvy Senior Influencer Executive to join our team dedicated to L'Oréal. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving successful influencer marketing campaigns that align with L'Oréal's brand objectives.

As the Senior Influencer Executive, you will lead influencer strategy and campaign execution across social platforms to amplify brand awareness, drive engagement, and grow our community within the beauty space.

You’ll be responsible for managing influencer relationships, developing creative campaign concepts, and ensuring brand alignment with both macro and micro creators.


Key Responsibilities

  • Influencer Strategy & Campaign Management
    • Develop and execute influencer campaigns for new product launches, brand awareness, and seasonal initiatives.
    • Identify and onboard relevant beauty influencers (macro, micro, and nano) across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
    • Create and manage influencer briefs, contracts, timelines, and budgets.
    • Oversee influencer content production to ensure brand tone, aesthetic, and compliance with marketing guidelines.
  • Relationship Management
    • Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier beauty influencers, talent managers, and agencies.
    • Act as the main point of contact for influencer collaborations and ongoing partnerships.
  • Performance & Reporting
    • Monitor and analyse influencer campaign performance using analytics tools.
    • Deliver insights and recommendations to optimize future campaigns.
    • Report on ROI, engagement metrics, and audience growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with PR, social media, e-commerce, and creative teams to ensure consistent messaging and amplification.
    • Support integrated marketing initiatives that combine influencer, content, and brand storytelling.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, preferably within the beauty, cosmetics, or lifestyle industry.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and influencer ecosystems.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using tools like Traackr, or similar.
  • Creative eye for beauty trends, social storytelling, and content aesthetics.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Existing network of beauty influencers or creators.
  • Experience with paid and seeding influencer amplification or affiliate programs.
  • Understanding of emerging platforms (e.g., TikTok Shop, Threads, YouTube Shorts).

Benefits 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

We aim to facilitate an accessible and positive application experience for all candidates. If you require any adjustments from us to support you through the process or expect to require any adjustments to working conditions to be able to best perform in the role, please let us know. We are happy to consider all reasonable adjustments.

If you live with a disability and you would like to take advantage of our offer of a guaranteed interview under the Disability Confident Scheme, please ensure you fill out our voluntary Equal Opportunities Questionnaire when applying.

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Manager | US Market (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for a Senior Influencer Marketing Manager to drive our creator partnerships in the US. In this role, you will build relationships with the creators and celebrities who shape American beauty culture, own campaigns from strategy to results, and personally drive a significant share of our US targets.

Your tasks

  • Manage a portfolio of influencers, key partners and multiple sub-projects within the assigned market.

  • Remain actively involved in campaign execution, contributing at least 30% to total country targets.

  • Develop and implement best practices to ensure high execution standards, efficiency, and continuous KPI optimization.

  • Take full ownership of influencer marketing projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery of all initiatives.

  • Supervise country-level campaign country planning, team targets, monitoring progress and ensuring alignment with overall company goals.

  • Track US beauty, social, and creator trends, and turn insights into local campaigns and partnerships that grow the brand in the US market.

Your profile

  • Proven track record in executing profitable and high-performing influencer marketing campaigns, delivering measurable business impact.

  • Over 4 years of experience in influencer marketing in the US, ideally within fast-paced or high-growth environments.

  • Strong understanding of the U.S. beauty market, including key trends, consumer behavior, and creator landscape.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, capable of handling multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to balance strategic thinking and day-to-day execution.

  • Data-driven and performance-oriented, with a focus on ROI, reach growth, and campaign optimization.

  • Collaborative team player with strong communication and leadership skills; team management experience is a must.

What We Offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
descriptionHtml:
Senior Internal Auditor 

Our passion at SumUp is championing small businesses. We believe in creating technology that is flexible, fair, affordable and easy to use. Every day millions of people around the world dream of starting their own businesses. We strive to help them to do this. Our long-term goal is to close the loop by enabling businesses to turn transactions with customers into long-term relationships. 

We are looking for a Senior Internal Auditor to join our team at SumUp and help us ensure compliance, assess risks, and strengthen internal controls within the organisation, with a particular focus on European regulation. The Senior Internal Auditor will help implement the best industry practices for a robust and proactive internal auditing function at SumUp.

The Senior Auditor will report directly to the Global Head of Internal Audit. This person will work closely with the Board, Audit Committee, key stakeholders and external auditors. This is an individual contributor role. If you're looking for a role where your work genuinely matters and your voice is heard, this is it.

What you’ll do:

  • Plan and conduct regulatory, compliance, and operational audits across SumUp's European markets
  • Prepare audit reports, present findings to management, and recommend improvements
  • Contribute towards the development and improvement of the Internal Audit plan, framework, methodology and templates
  • Coordinate internal audit-related projects together with the relevant teams
  • Manage relationships with stakeholders and foster a proactive culture towards internal controls and compliance

You’ll be great for this role if you have:

    • Strong audit experience in financial services, ideally within payments or regulated fintech
    • Deep knowledge of the European regulatory environment and internal controls frameworks
    • Comfort operating in large, complex, international organisations where priorities shift
    • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to act as a credible partner at all levels
    • A natural curiosity for data, with the ability to look beyond the numbers and draw sound conclusions
    • Need for internal audit experience in-house, with the ability to help establish and grow this capability

💚 Why You Should Join SumUp

🇬🇧 London, United Kingdom

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success
🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves
🏥 Health matters: Vitality health cover, including optical and dental
🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta
💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)
🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Senior Java Developer (Performance Focused)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a senior Java engineer with a strong performance engineering background to join a global financial technology platform team in Zurich.

What you will be doing

You will work within a cross-functional Scrum team on a high-throughput, enterprise-grade platform serving the global Securities Finance and Collateral market. Your focus will be on identifying and eliminating performance bottlenecks, rearchitecting critical components for scalability, and driving the platform's technical evolution alongside senior architects.


What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on Java enterprise development (Java SE/JEE, Spring, JPA/Hibernate)

  • Real performance engineering experience acquired through development work: profiling, GC tuning, load testing, bottleneck analysis

  • Strong SQL skills (Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server)

  • Background in financial services or high-throughput enterprise systems

  • Solid understanding of software design and enterprise architectural patterns

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

 

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.

 

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

 

Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.

 

Problems you'll work on

  • Interactive inference in the annotation editor. Serving heavy vision and multimodal models fast enough that annotators get model suggestions in real time, with their corrections flowing back as feedback.

  • Inference at very large scale. Pre-computing model outputs across millions of hours of egocentric video for robotics customers, where throughput, GPU cost and reliability all matter.

  • Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature.

  • One integration, many workflows. Building model integrations that hold up across customers' custom, fast-changing ontologies and task templates, instead of one-off implementations.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and operate model-serving and inference infrastructure for transformer-based vision and multimodal models

  • Own the serving architecture behind our ML features, justifying trade-offs in latency, throughput, reliability and GPU cost

  • Optimise models and pipelines for production through batching, KV caching, GPU utilisation and orchestration

  • Integrate models into Encord's product and annotation workflows together with Product Engineering

  • Build reusable abstractions that work across models, data types, customers and changing task templates

  • Set up monitoring and observability, and own performance and reliability once features are live

  • Take prototypes from your research-focused teammates and turn them into shipped features

  • Contribute to platform design decisions, take part in design reviews and help us hire

  • Work with Python, PyTorch, CUDA, Kubernetes and GCP/AWS

     

Who we're looking for

  • An owner. You take ambiguous product needs, make the architecture calls and carry the work all the way into production.

  • A systems thinker. You design for scale and reuse, and you know when a simple, solid baseline beats a clever solution.

  • A great collaborator. You enjoy working across research, product and engineering, and you make it easier for everyone to ship.

  • A bridge between research and production. You speak both languages, help researchers get their work shipped, and feed production lessons back into how models are built.

 

Experience requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time building and operating ML systems or model-backed products in production at scale

  • Strong software engineering and system design fundamentals

  • Hands-on experience deploying modern deep learning models in production, with a strong understanding of model serving, inference optimisation, GPU utilisation and performance trade-offs.

  • Experience designing and operating scalable, distributed production systems, ideally involving GPU workloads, high-throughput data processing or low-latency inference.

  • The ability to reason through an ML system end to end, from data and model choices to offline and online evaluation, deployment, monitoring and retraining

  • A track record of personally owning complex systems from design through to production

  • Bonus: computer vision or multimodal deployment experience (not required), model-serving frameworks, or experience with video, 3D or other complex data types

 

Why Encord

title: Senior Manager Account Management
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Account Management is where DataSnipper grows. Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. The growth won't come from renewals that run themselves. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other.

As Senior Manager, Account Management – EMEA, you'll lead a team of 5 Account Managers, report to our EMEA Sales leader, and own retention, expansion and forecast accuracy for the region. This is a player-coach role in spirit. You'll be in the deals and in front of senior partners and executives, not managing from a dashboard.

Why DataSnipper

The best commercial opportunities don't come around every day. Selling technology that's transforming an entire industry is one of them.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our commercial teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

If you're commercially driven, ambitious, and excited to build something bigger, this is you chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and accelerate your own career along the way.

What You Will Do

Lead and Build the Team

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of 5 AMs, with hands-on deal coaching on renewal strategy, negotiation and executive engagement

  • Raise the talent bar: make the calls on the existing team and hire native speakers for under-covered markets (Dutch, German, French, Spanish)

  • Rebalance books as account loads move from 200 per rep toward 110, so every AM has room to go deep

Own the Number

  • Own gross and net revenue retention, expansion and multi-year commitments across the EMEA Accounting book

  • Bring a strategic lens to renewals: move customers up-market on packaging and from legacy products onto our AI platform

  • Lead high-stakes negotiations with senior partners and executives at Europe's leading accounting firms, including network and multi-entity agreements, price increases, multi-year commitments and competitive displacement threats

  • Build and present business cases that tie DataSnipper to the outcomes partners care about: audit quality, capacity, margin and talent retention. Business conversations, not feature walkthroughs

Build Forecast Discipline

  • Build a renewal and expansion forecasting method that sees at least a full quarter out (today we see 2 months), ideally run in Gong

  • Run the operating cadence with your team and the CS leaders: renewal reviews, deal rooms and pipeline inspection

Be the Voice of the EMEA Customer

  • Partner with Customer Success on adoption and risk, with Product on what customers need from Agents, and with Marketing on firm-level programs

  • Bring sharp, data-backed insight on churn risk, competitor activity and pricing pressure to senior leadership

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 2–3 years leading an Account Management or renewals/expansion team (team leads ready to step up are welcome)

  • A track record of renewing and expanding a product that didn't sell itself. We want commercial operators, not relationship managers

  • Strong negotiation skills: you trade concessions for commitments, you don't give too much too early, and you've negotiated directly with economic buyers

  • Credibility with senior executives: you've had business value conversations with partners, CFOs or managing directors and built business cases with real numbers that won their approval

  • Deep discovery skills: you ask the 2nd, 3rd and 4th question until you reach the real business problem

  • A forecasting method you've actually run, and the discipline to inspect it weekly

  • Urgency and a competitive streak. You'd rather get on a plane to see the customer than send another email

  • Coachable, and able to coach others. You can name feedback that changed how you work

  • Experience moving customers onto AI products is a strong plus

  • Audit, accounting or professional services software experience is a strong plus

  • Fluent English required. Dutch, German, French or Spanish is a strong plus

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

  • Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

Recruitment Process

  • Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  • Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site)

  • Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀
