title: Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Mit unseren flexiblen Arbeitszeiten & Remote Work gestaltest du deinen Alltag so, wie er zu dir passt. Außerdem kannst du Überstunden ausgleichen. 
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei. 
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen. 

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Manager Commerce (Mensch) Retail Media bist du die strategische und operative Schlüsselfigur für unsere Großkund. Du verantwortest die ganzheitliche Planung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Retail-Media-Aktivitäten – von Amazon und weiteren Marktplätzen über führende Retailer bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Formaten.

  • Strategie & Jahresplanung: Du entwickelst ganzheitliche Commerce- und Retail-Media-Strategien für deine Kunden, definierst KPI-Ziele und erstellst die Mediaplanung über alle relevanten Touchpoints und Funnel-Stufen hinweg.
  • Kundenführung & Management: Du führst den Kunden partnerschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe, steuerst die regelmäßige Kommunikation (inkl. internationaler Stakeholder) und präsentierst Ergebnisse sowie strategische Roadmaps in Reviews.
  • Ganzheitliche Kampagnensteuerung (A–Z): Du verantwortest das Kampagnenmanagement über das gesamte Retail-Netzwerk – von Amazon (Sponsored Ads & DSP) über führende Retailer (dm, Rossmann, REWE etc.) bis hin zu Video- und Audio-Aktivierungen (Prime Video, Spotify).
  • Operatives Setup & Aussteuerung: Du übernimmst das hands-on Kampagnen-Setup – von der Keyword- und Audience-Recherche über die Kampagnenstruktur bis hin zum täglichen Bid- und Pacing-Management, um Budgets optimal auszuschöpfen.
  • Laufende Optimierung & Testing: Du justierst Gebote, Match Types und Zielgruppen, führst Tests&Learn durch, optimierst und hebst kontinuierlich Performance-Potenziale.
  • Budget- & Rentabilitätsverantwortung: Du steuerst und überwachst signifikante Mediabudgets eigenverantwortlich, behältst ROAS sowie Effizienzmetriken im Blick und optimierst den Media-Mix kontinuierlich.
  • Datenanalyse & Insights: Du analysierst Performance-, Sortiments- und Marktdaten, erkennst Wachstumshebel und übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in klare Handlungsempfehlungen für den Kunden.
  • Fachliche Teamleitung: Du strukturierst und koordinierst Aufgaben innerhalb eines kleinen Teams, coachst Kolleg:innen auf Junior- und Mid-Level fachlich und sorgst für reibungslose operative Abläufe.
  • Innovation & Weiterentwicklung: Du treibst Best Practices voran, testest neue AdTech-Möglichkeiten und gestaltest die Entwicklung unseres Commerce-Bereichs aktiv mit.

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Retail Media, Performance Marketing oder E-Commerce (idealerweise auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite).
  • Fundiertes Plattform-Wissen: Du hast nachweisbare Praxis in der Planung, dem Setup und der Optimierung von Kampagnen im Bereich Advertising (Sponsored Ads und DSP).
  • Ganzheitliches Retail-Verständnis: Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Retailern und Marken (egal ob Drogerie, Food oder Marktplatz) und hast Lust, Kampagnen über mehrere Handelsplattformen hinweg strategisch zu orchestrieren.
  • Strategische & analytische Denkweise: Du denkst in Business-Zielen, verstehst Kennzahlen im Detail und kannst fundierte Mediapläne und Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln.
  • Souveräne Kundenführung: Du trittst überzeugend auf, kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich präsentieren und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Führungs- & Organisationsgeschick: Du hast Erfahrung darin, Aufgaben im Team strukturiert zu koordinieren, zu delegieren und Kolleg:innen fachlich zu unterstützen.
  • Persönlichkeit & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du denkst proaktiv mit, packst bei operativen Herausforderungen selbst mit an und bringst eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit.
  • Nice to Have: Erfahrungen mit weiteren Retail-Plattformen und AdTechs wie Criteo, CitrusAd oder The Trade Desk sowie Tools wie Pacvue, Skai oder Helium10. Kenntnisse in Streaming-Advertising und BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Looker Studio sind ebenfalls ein Plus.

 Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamorientiert #analytisch #kommunikativ #proaktiv #lösungsorientiert

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Commodities & Energy Trading, AI & Trading Transformation
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Commodities and Energy Trading practice is looking for an experienced Senior Manager (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich. 

We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, commercial optimisation, risk and regulation, flexibility integration, and technology delivery.

This is an opportunity to advise influential organisations on strategic priorities and deliver meaningful change across trading operations, commercial performance and new technologies, while playing a visible role in building our German and European business.

What you will be doing

As a Senior Manager in our Commodities & Energy Trading practice, you will help clients navigate changing commodity markets by combining trading expertise with the practical application of data, analytics and AI. 

You will play a key role in shaping and delivering our commodity and energy trading proposition: leading client engagements, developing new opportunities and showing clients where AI and advanced analytics can create genuine commercial value.

You are likely to bring deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with some understanding or practical exposure to the other. You will work alongside specialists from both disciplines, building on your core expertise while continuing to deepen your capabilities across the intersection of trading and AI. The aim is to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, measurable improvements in how trading businesses operate.

AI & Trading Transformation

  • Shape propositions at the intersection of commodity trading, AI and digital transformation, and bring market insight on how AI is changing trading organisations, business models and competitive dynamics
  • Translate real trading problems into practical GenAI and agentic use cases that deliver value to clients
  • Advise clients on where AI should augment human decision-making, where workflows can be automated, and where human judgement remains critical
  • Design trading journeys from opportunity identification and experimentation through to scaled adoption, with the metrics and value cases that show impact on performance, productivity, risk and profitability
  • Work with traders, portfolio managers, data scientists and technology teams to turn concepts into solutions that operate in live trading environments
  • Drive adoption of GenAI copilots, agents and intelligent workflows that improve trader productivity and decision quality
  • Establish governance, model risk, human oversight and responsible-use approaches without losing sight of commercial outcomes

Commodities & Energy Trading

  • Advise on front-to-back trading processes, from market intelligence and trade origination through execution, scheduling, settlement and risk management across commodities including Power, Oil & Refined Products, Natural Gas, LNG, Metals, Renewables and Environmental Products
  • Support clients in evolving their trading strategies, operating models and capabilities in response to changing markets and new technologies
  • Bring an understanding of market structure, pricing, forecasting, physical flows and the commercial decisions that drive trading performance

 
Your skills and experience 

We are looking for an experienced professional with 8-12+ years of relevant experience and a strong background in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI. The strongest candidates will combine meaningful experience across both areas. However, we also welcome applicants who bring deep expertise in one discipline alongside a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other.

You might be a commodities and trading specialist who has applied data, analytics or AI to trading decisions, processes or transformation, or a data and AI practitioner who has worked in, or gained exposure to, commodities, energy or another trading environment.

You do not need equal depth in both disciplines, but you should be able to demonstrate a genuine foundation in each and a clear motivation to deepen your experience at their intersection.

What we look for in everyone

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to engage credibly with senior trading and executive stakeholders
  • The ability to distinguish genuinely valuable AI opportunities from technology-led experimentation
  • Experience contributing to or leading complex transformation, strategy or operating-model engagements
  • Strong leadership, communication and team-development skills
  • Deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other discipline and the commitment to continue building depth across both

If your primary background is in commodities and trading, you will ideally bring

  • Deep expertise in at least one commodity, such as Power, Gas, LNG, Oil, Metals or Environmental Products
  • A strong understanding of trading, portfolio management, risk, physical flows, scheduling, optimisation and/or commercial operations
  • Familiarity with ETRM/CTRM platforms and the wider trading technology and data ecosystems
  • Some experience of using, sponsoring or shaping data, analytics, automation or AI initiatives within a trading or commercial environment, together with an understanding of how these capabilities can improve trading decisions, processes and outcomes

If your primary background is in data, analytics and AI, you will ideally bring

  • Practical experience identifying, shaping or delivering AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent automation use cases
  • An understanding of the opportunities and limitations of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and decision-support tools, and how they apply in a trading environment
  • Some experience of commodities, energy, financial markets or trading environments, with an understanding of how trading organisations make decisions, manage risk and generate value, together with a strong interest in deepening your knowledge of commodity markets and front-to-back trading processes

What a career at Baringa will give you 

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 days every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. title: Senior Manager Communications (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten im Büro und mit dem Team der ‚Biodiversity in Good Company‘ Initiative e.V. zusammen sowie mit den Partnerorganisationen des Konsortiums im Vorhaben Unternehmen Biologische Vielfalt 2030 (UBi 2030).

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Kommunikations- und Öffentlichkeitsstrategie inklusive der Weiterentwicklung einer Corporate Identity und des visuellen Erscheinungsbildes

  • fundierte Mitarbeit an der Gesamtstrategie des Vorhabens

  • Externe Kommunikation und Vernetzung mit Unternehmen, Medien, Politik, Wissenschaft und weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern

  • Planung, Erstellung und Redaktion zielgruppenspezifischer Inhalte, wie zum Beispiel Newsletter, Beiträge für Webseiten und Social Media, Pressemitteilungen, Fachartikel, Interviews und Statements

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Medienkontakten sowie Steuerung der Pressearbeit

  • Optimierung von Webseiten hinsichtlich Nutzerfreundlichkeit, Reichweite und Sichtbarkeit, inklusive der Analyse von relevanten Kennzahlen unter Berücksichtigung von SEO und GEO-Strategien

  • Beobachtung relevanter politischer, wirtschaftlicher und gesellschaftlicher Entwicklungen im Themenfeld Biodiversität und Nachhaltigkeit sowie eigene Recherchen

Ihr Profil

Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich und setzen Prioritäten, um das übergeordnete Ziel der Erhöhung der Sichtbarkeit zu erreichen. Dabei bringen Sie eigene Ideen ein und haben Spaß daran, komplexe Themen zu Biodiversität und Wirtschaft zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln. Mit Ihrer Arbeit kreieren Sie einen positiven Impact.

Idealerweise bringen Sie mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Journalismus, PR- und Marketing, Politik-, Umwelt- oder Nachhaltigkeitswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Kommunikation oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • mindestens drei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in Kommunikation und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit

  • Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in deutscher Sprache (C1 oder Muttersprache) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kommunikationsstrategien

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Pressearbeit, Storytelling und Content-Erstellung (Social Media und weitere digitale Kommunikationskanäle)

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Office-Anwendungen (Microsoft, Planner, Copilot usw.) und Websitemanagement (typo 3)

  • Gute Erfahrung in der redaktionellen Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Websites, inklusive SEO und GEO (Content-Optimierung für KI-gestützte Suchsysteme oder verwandte digitale Sichtbarkeitsstrategien)

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich, prägnant und zielgruppenorientiert aufzubereiten

  • Ausgeprägtes Organisations- und Projektmanagementtalent

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Hohe Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Akteuren aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Naturschutz

  • Hohes Interesse an Nachhaltigkeit, Biodiversität und gesellschaftlicher Transformation

  • Kenntnisse der Nachhaltigkeits- und Biodiversitätsdebatte sowie relevanter politischer Prozesse sind von Vorteil

  • Kenntnisse der Vorgaben zur Verwendung von Bundesfördermitteln sowie der damit verbundenen Abrechnungs-, Vergabe- und Dokumentationspflichten sind von Vorteil

Angebot

Wir bieten einen Arbeitsplatz mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Lernpotential in einem spannenden Themenumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft, Naturschutz und Politik. Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell. Für diese Position sind durchschnittlich 2 bis 3 Präsenztage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro vorgesehen.

Vielfalt erwünscht

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Dauer der Verarbeitung oder Dauer der Datenspeicherung

Der 'Biodiversity in Good Company‘ Initiative e. V. wird Ihre Daten nicht länger verarbeiten und speichern, als dies für den genannten Zweck erforderlich ist. Widerrufsrecht

title: Senior Manager, Corporate & International Tax
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Manager to join Volta’s tax function and lead delivery across corporate and international tax. This role would suit someone looking to move in-house at a fast-scaling, capital-intensive platform.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, this is a hands-on delivery role. The Senior Manager will own the group’s corporate tax compliance and reporting workstreams, implement international tax policies, and monitor governance to ensure tax structures are operating as intended, with genuine scope for the remit to grow as the function and business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Lead the day-to-day management of corporate tax compliance across the group, coordinating local Finance teams and external advisers to ensure accurate and timely filings.

  • Review corporate tax computations, returns and supporting schedules, escalating material positions and judgement calls to the VP of Tax.

  • Maintain oversight of tax payments, instalments, filing obligations and elections across jurisdictions.

  • Own the preparation and coordination of current and deferred tax calculations, tax disclosures and supporting documentation for financial reporting and audit.

  • Build and maintain group cash-tax forecasts and effective tax rate analysis, explaining key movements, risks and opportunities.

  • Track tax losses, capital allowances, interest restrictions and other tax attributes, ensuring they are reflected consistently in returns, reporting and forecasts.

International Tax

  • Execute the technical analysis and implementation of international tax policies and structures agreed with the VP of Tax.

  • Monitor the group’s permanent-establishment, tax-residence and substance positions as the business expands into new markets.

  • Manage withholding-tax and repatriation workstreams, including treaty relief, supporting documentation and coordination with local advisers.

  • Assess the corporate and international tax implications of new entities, cross-border activities and intercompany arrangements.

  • Support tax planning for intangible assets and intellectual property (IP), including ownership, development, licensing and cross-border transfers, working with the VP of Tax, Legal and external advisers to align arrangements with commercial objectives, substance and transfer-pricing requirements.

  • Monitor the group’s obligations under Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and other international tax reporting regimes, coordinating implementation and filings where applicable.

  • Bring forward clear recommendations on technical questions, with the commercial and risk trade-offs spelled out.

  • Flag material tax developments and translate them into practical actions for the group.

Transfer Pricing & Intercompany Arrangements

  • Lead the day-to-day implementation of the group’s transfer-pricing policies, working with Finance, Legal and external advisers.

  • Coordinate transfer-pricing documentation, benchmarking and local reporting requirements across jurisdictions.

  • Monitor intercompany charges and financing arrangements to ensure they reflect agreed policies, contractual terms and the activities performed.

  • Work with Finance to implement intercompany calculations, invoicing and year-end adjustments.

  • Maintain supporting documentation for intercompany services, financing, intellectual property and other material cross-border arrangements.

  • Identify changes in functions, assets or risks that may require updates to the group’s transfer-pricing approach.

Governance & Risk

  • Help operate Volta’s tax governance framework and controls on a day-to-day basis and keep the tax risk register current.

  • Build and maintain supporting documentation for material tax positions, elections and arrangements.

  • Monitor whether group structures are operating as intended, including governance, substance and intercompany arrangements.

  • Manage the working relationship with Big Four and legal advisers on corporate and international tax matters, escalating scope, cost or quality issues.

  • Coordinate responses to tax authority enquiries, audits and information requests, escalating significant matters to the VP of Tax.

  • Maintain clear ownership, deadlines and evidence of review across tax compliance and reporting processes.

Business Partnering

  • Act as the day-to-day corporate and international tax contact for Finance, Legal, People and other internal teams.

  • Give practical, timely tax input on new markets, operating arrangements and business initiatives.

  • Support Capital Markets and Corporate Development on transactions, drawing on the group’s tax positions, attributes and compliance requirements.

  • Coordinate with colleagues and advisers responsible for VAT/GST, employment taxes and other specialist areas where issues overlap.

  • Prepare materials and analysis for the VP of Tax ahead of CFO, leadership, investor and auditor conversations.

  • Take ownership of agreed workstreams end-to-end, escalating judgement calls and anything strategically significant to the VP of Tax.

Process & Team Support

  • Help the VP of Tax roll out new processes, controls and systems as the function scales.

  • Improve the quality and availability of tax data, working closely with Finance on reporting and reconciliation processes.

  • Identify opportunities for automation and standardisation in tax compliance, reporting and intercompany processes.

  • Manage or mentor junior tax analysts and associates as the team grows.

About You

Experience & Qualifications

  • Strong relevant tax experience, typically Big Four Senior Manager to Associate Director level, or the in-house equivalent – someone used to taking ownership of corporate and international tax delivery across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Professional qualification: CTA, ACA, CA or equivalent.

  • Solid technical grounding in corporate and international tax, including transfer pricing, withholding taxes, permanent establishments, tax residence and treaty matters.

  • Hands-on experience managing corporate tax compliance and external advisers across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Proven experience with tax accounting, current and deferred tax provisions, and financial statement disclosures.

  • Comfortable building and reviewing cash-tax forecasts and effective tax rate analysis, and explaining the commercial implications.

  • Experience implementing tax policies and intercompany arrangements, with an understanding of the documentation and processes needed to make them work in practice.

Skills & Attributes

  • Execution-focused and detail-oriented, with good judgement about what to escalate and when.

  • Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end while operating within a strategy set by someone else.

  • Strong project-management skills, coordinating multiple jurisdictions, deadlines and internal and external stakeholders at once.

  • A clear communicator, able to explain complex tax positions to non-tax audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative, energised by building good process in a fast-moving environment.

  • Able to connect technical tax requirements with the group’s commercial activities, financial reporting and cash flow.

Desirable Experience

  • Background in private equity, infrastructure funds, real assets, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Time in a start-up or rapidly scaling international organisation.

  • Exposure to data centres or other capital-intensive infrastructure businesses.

  • Familiarity with UK, European and US tax environments.

  • Experience with Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and international tax transparency requirements.

  • Exposure to cross-border financing, restructurings or acquisitions.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Skills & Experience You'll Need

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. .

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Senior Manager, New Business Accounts DACH & Benelux.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • 7+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company.

  • Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business objectives.

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent required. 
  • Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence. 
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. .

title: Senior Manager, Obligations Management
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As the Senior Manager, Obligations Management, you'll manage and continue to develop the central governance infrastructure used to identify, catalogue, and track regulatory and financial partner requirements across Airwallex’s global footprint. You’ll translate complex requirements into a structured, data-driven, and audit-ready compliance inventory that supports consistent execution across a distributed global organization.

  • Own and continuously improve the Global Obligations Register, cataloguing international regulatory rules, statutory requirements, and Tier 1 financial partner obligations alongside their compliance controls.

  • Partner with Risk and Compliance stakeholders to structure mapped controls and reporting obligations for effective independent monitoring, validation, and testing.

  • Manage and evolve the central global RFI knowledge base, synthesising input from Regulatory Compliance teams and curating consistent, well-supported evidence portfolios for banking partners and regulatory bodies.

  • Maintain the global central audit register, tracking internal audit findings, external examination gaps, and material regulatory issues while driving accountability for remediation and verified closure.

  • Partner with Regulatory Legal teams to incorporate legal interpretations and horizon-scanning insights, keeping the obligations registry current and reducing the risk of compliance gaps or control drift.

  • Establish and improve operating procedures, data standards, governance routines, and reporting for obligations management, RFI responses, and audit issue tracking.

  • Identify opportunities to replace manual trackers and spreadsheet dependencies with scalable GRC tooling, workflow automation, and compliance dashboards, supporting implementation and adoption with relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate and influence regional and cross-functional contributors to maintain consistent central standards while reflecting local regulatory requirements.

  • Produce clear management reporting and concise analysis on obligations coverage, control mapping, RFI readiness, audit issues, remediation progress, and emerging risks.

This is a remote role based in Birmingham, UK.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8 to 10+ years of experience in corporate governance, regulatory compliance, internal audit, operational risk management, or a related discipline within a highly regulated financial services, fintech, or banking environment.

  • 3+ years of experience managing a compliance inventory, regulatory obligations framework, audit issue program, RFI process, or GRC work stream in a multi-jurisdictional environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building or maintaining compliance matrices, mapping internal controls to regulatory requirements, managing audit or examination issues, and coordinating evidence or RFI responses.

  • Strong ability to translate complex regulatory or legal requirements into clear processes, data structures, ownership models, and actionable reporting.

  • A high-ownership, systematic approach to problem-solving, with strong written communication and corporate drafting skills.

  • Proven ability to influence and coordinate regional and cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed organization without relying solely on formal authority.

  • Experience improving operational processes and implementing practical tooling, workflows, or reporting solutions in a fast-growing environment.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Public Policy, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related analytical discipline.

  • Juris Doctor, Master of Laws, or a master’s degree in Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, or Business Administration.

  • Professional designation such as Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist, Certified Internal Auditor, or an equivalent GRC-related credential.

  • Experience working within a high-growth cross-border payments company, top-tier neobank, or API-driven digital platform handling high volumes of regulated transactions.

  • Direct experience selecting, deploying, or configuring Governance, Risk, and Compliance software to support regulatory mapping, evidence management, issue remediation, or workflow automation.

  • Experience leading projects or mentoring colleagues in obligations management, regulatory change management, compliance operations, audit, or related programs.

You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Consumer Products & Retail Transformation practice are looking for a Senior Manager/Director to join the team

Our Consumer Products & Retail practice is looking for an experienced Senior Manager or Director to join the team and help our clients deliver complex, business-critical transformation.

We are seeking a highly motivated consulting leader with a strong track record of designing and delivering large-scale transformation programmes within the consumer products and retail sectors. This could include experience across supply chain transformation, S&OP, planning and forecasting, ERP-enabled transformation, or operating model design and implementation.

This is a broad transformation leadership role rather than a position focused on a single functional specialism. The right person will combine strong consulting and programme leadership capabilities with the commercial confidence to lead client relationships, manage complex engagements, and identify opportunities to deepen and grow existing accounts.

Candidates may have built their career entirely within consulting or combined consulting with relevant industry experience. However, substantial consulting experience and a clear understanding of how to lead clients through complex transformation are essential.

What we are looking for

You will be a pragmatic transformation leader who is comfortable moving between strategic thinking and the realities of implementation. You will understand what it takes to mobilise and deliver complex programmes, engage senior client stakeholders, and create alignment across business and technology teams.

You do not need to be a pure business development or new-logo origination specialist. However, you must be comfortable owning senior client relationships, leading the day-to-day development of accounts, and identifying opportunities to broaden our impact with existing clients.

You will also bring enough depth in consumer products or retail to understand the commercial and operational context in which clients are transforming, while retaining the breadth to work across different types of transformation challenge.

What you will be doing

  • Lead complex transformation engagements for consumer products and retail clients, taking responsibility for successful delivery from initial design through to implementation.
  • Help clients shape and deliver transformation across areas such as supply chain, S&OP, business planning, forecasting, ERP implementation, and operating model effectiveness.
  • Translate strategic objectives into practical transformation roadmaps, delivery plans, governance structures, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead the day-to-day management of major client accounts and engagements, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a confident and credible account leader who can strengthen client relationships, identify emerging needs, and grow existing accounts.
  • Oversee complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, business functions, technology platforms, geographies, and stakeholder groups.
  • Work across business and technology teams to ensure that transformation programmes deliver sustainable operational improvements rather than standalone systems or process changes.
  • Advise clients on the organisational, process, capability, data, and technology changes required to deliver successful transformation.
  • Provide clear leadership to multidisciplinary project teams, creating an environment in which consultants can perform effectively and develop their capabilities.
  • Manage programme risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, governance, and senior stakeholder expectations.
  • Support business development activity through proposal development, solution design, client presentations, and the expansion of existing relationships.
  • Contribute to the continued development of our Consumer Products & Retail practice, including its propositions, delivery capabilities, market profile, and people.

Your skills and experience

  • Significant experience within consulting, with a strong track record of leading complex transformation engagements for consumer products or retail clients.
  • Experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or an equivalent level within a recognised consulting organisation.
  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more of the following areas:
    • Supply chain transformation
    • Sales and operations planning, or S&OP
    • Demand, supply, or integrated business planning
    • Forecasting and planning transformation
    • ERP-enabled business transformation
    • Operating model design and implementation
    • Complex programme leadership
  • Experience leading major transformation programmes from strategy and design through to implementation and business adoption.
  • A strong understanding of how business processes, operating models, data, technology, organisation design, and change management come together within a successful transformation.
  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary consulting teams and manage multiple workstreams within complex client environments.
  • Strong client engagement and account management skills, with the confidence to work with senior client stakeholders and manage important day-to-day relationships.
  • Evidence of growing or expanding existing client accounts by identifying additional client needs and converting them into relevant opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing engagement economics, delivery quality, scope, risk, and client expectations.
  • The ability to communicate complex transformation topics clearly and credibly to both business and technology stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving, facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a strong commitment to coaching and developing consulting talent.
  • Industry experience gained before, during, or after a consulting career would be valuable, but candidates must bring substantial and current consulting capability.

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.

title: (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager to lead our organisation and team in the UK as Market Lead and be the public face of Change.org in the country. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through deep networks across UK politics, civil society, civic tech, newsrooms, broadcasters, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle.

We'd welcome ambitious and entrepreneurial Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role.

Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions.

What you will achieve

  • Create awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Turn those moments into measurable growth for Change.org in the UK, such as new petition starters, signers and supporters. At a Senior Manager level, own the UK team's goals and report on how campaigns contribute to Change.org's wider growth targets.

  • Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Coach them on strategy, find the route to victory, and help them build the pressure that gets decision makers to act.

  • Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks, transparent reporting and training into how the team works, so every campaign protects our trusted, non-partisan brand.

  • Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society, civic tech and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers. Show up in person at the events, meetings and petition deliveries where those relationships are built, many of them in London and Westminster.

  • Be our voice. Act as Change.org's external spokesperson in the UK on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations.

  • Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership where people feel supported, trusted and able to do their best work, alongside a pace that matches the news cycle. Work closely with product, data and colleagues in other markets, and contribute to global campaigns and projects. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team, and lead or shape at least one cross-functional or global project that moves a wider business goal.

  • Lead with AI, shape the product. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter. Work closely with Change.org’s product team as the voice of UK user groups. Test new tools and features early, feed back what works and what doesn’t, and turn launches into moments in the UK, showing petition starters how new features can help them win.

What you bring

  • A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks. You use performance data and testing to decide which stories to back, how to pitch them and when to change course.

  • Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts.

  • An active network. You have active and trusted networks into UK politics (including key decision makers), civil society and civic tech, across the whole democratic political spectrum, including on the left, in the centre and on the right. You bring trusted relationships with UK journalists, editors and producers. You can use your contacts to place stories and move decision makers.

  • Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You care about the people you manage and know how to build a team that’s positive, ambitious and pulls together under pressure. You’re happy rolling up your sleeves alongside them. At Senior Manager level, you have hired, managed performance and navigated team conflict, and you adapt your style to get the best from each person.

  • Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are confident on camera and in front of senior stakeholders, with some spokesperson experience or the appetite to build it.

  • AI-first, curious about civic tech. You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along. You’re excited by new tools and how people use them. You’re comfortable testing features, spotting what users need, and giving product teams clear, practical feedback.

Target experience

  • 5-8+ years in digital campaigning, political campaigns and communications or public affairs, at a campaigning organisation, charity, political party or agency.

  • 3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team.

  • A proven track record of national campaigns in the UK that created significant public attention and media coverage.

  • Experience as an organisation's spokesperson in national broadcast and / or print media.

  • Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work.

Interested? Great! Here's what you should know

This is a full-time, remote role based in the United Kingdom. Deep networks into UK politics, civil society and civic tech are core to the role, as is regular, in-person presence at events, meetings and petition deliveries, many of which happen in London. We expect up to weekly travel into London and travel costs to London are not covered by Change.org.

Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is £86,000 in the UK. We are also open to candidates at the Manager level and the annual salary in the UK is £75,500. These salaries are the same wherever in the UK you live.

We recognise that people assess their qualifications differently, and you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe you could be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. Change.org is an open platform designed to serve people across the full range of viewpoints. Effectively supporting that mission requires teams with a wide variety of experiences, skills and perspectives, which we consider essential to our work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. We consider all applicants without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, gender identity or expression, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We're committed to protecting your data. To learn more, please review our Change.org Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

We are committed to making reasonable adjustments for candidates throughout our recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, please let your recruiter know.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.
We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.
Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis.
Responsibilities

  • Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds.

  • Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production.

  • Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times.

  • Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early.

  • Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations.

  • Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers.

  • Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria.

  • Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering.


    • Requirements

  • You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units.

  • You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection.

  • You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts.

  • You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline.

  • You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers.

  • You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar.

  • You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing.

    • If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

As Senior Motion Planning Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping how our autonomous ground systems navigate safely, efficiently, and robustly through complex environments. You will take strong technical ownership of motion planning systems, architecture, and engineering decisions. You will contribute hands-on to complex technical challenges, challenge existing approaches, evaluate trade-offs, and continuously improve the reliability, scalability, and real-world performance of our planning capabilities.

As a senior engineer, you will act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with teams across perception, localization and mapping, control, simulation, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex autonomy challenges into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces, requirements, and technical priorities across teams and support the transition of motion planning capabilities from development and simulation onto physical vehicles operating in the field.

What is your Day to Day Mission:
